63da17c1.title: SAP S/4 HANA Solution Architect-PP/QM & PM
63da17c1.description:
**Company Description** 
 PwC India is part of a global network that helps clients build trust, manage risk, and transform their businesses to gain competitive advantage. With more than 364,000 professionals in 136 countries and 137 territories, PwC delivers services across audit and assurance, tax and legal, deals, and consulting. The firm combines deep industry expertise with technology\-enabled solutions to help organizations accelerate and sustain momentum. Each member firm within the PwC network is a separate legal entity, enabling locally relevant services supported by global resources and standards. More information about PwC and its structure is available at www.pwc.com.
   

**Role Description** 
 This full\-time, on\-site SAP S/4 HANA Solution Architect\-PP/QM \& PM role is based in Bengaluru. The role involves designing end\-to\-end SAP S/4 HANA solutions for Production Planning (PP), Quality Management (QM), and Plant Maintenance (PM) that align with client business processes and strategic objectives. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include leading solution design workshops, translating business requirements into technical specifications, and overseeing configuration and integration activities across SAP and non\-SAP systems. The role also includes collaborating with consulting and delivery teams, guiding developers during build and testing phases, resolving complex functional and technical issues, and ensuring solutions follow best practices and PwC quality standards. The architect will support proposals, estimations, and client presentations, and contribute to continuous improvement of methodologies and accelerators.
   

**Qualifications**
* Strong Solution Architecture skills in SAP S/4 HANA, with hands\-on expertise in PP, QM, and PM modules.
* Consulting capabilities, including requirements gathering, stakeholder management, and business advisory experience.
* Experience with Software Development lifecycles, working closely with technical teams on design, build, and testing.
* Integration skills across SAP and third\-party systems, including data flows, interfaces, and middleware.
* Business Process knowledge in manufacturing, quality management, maintenance operations, and related supply chain processes.
* Prior experience in SAP implementation or transformation projects, preferably in a client\-facing role.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field.
* Relevant SAP certifications in S/4 HANA or specific PP/QM/PM modules are an advantage.
* Ability to work collaboratively in diverse teams, with strong communication and problem\-solving skills.
* Willingness to work on\-site in Bengaluru and occasionally travel for client engagements, as required.

42ef187a.title: Lead Solution Architect
42ef187a.description:
**Who We Are**
 WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40\+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best\-in\-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.
   

  

 The opportunity
   

  

 We are seeking a highly seasoned and visionary Lead Solution Architect to drive the digital transformation of our enterprise technology landscape. In this role, you will be the definitive technical authority responsible for designing, integrating, and scaling complex ecosystems that span E\-commerce platforms, Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems, and Content Management Systems (CMS).
   

  

 You will bridge the gap between business strategy and technical execution, designing modern, cloud\-native, and headless/composable solutions. The ideal candidate brings a wealth of experience in enterprise architecture and a proven portfolio of successfully leading multi\-million\-dollar digital commerce transformations.
   

  

 What you’ll be doing
   

  

* Enterprise Architecture \& Solution Design
* Define and own the end\-to\-end technical architecture for digital platforms, seamlessly integrating E\-commerce engines, CMS (Digital Experience Platforms), and CRM systems.
* Champion modern architectural paradigms, specifically MACH (Microservices, API\-first, Cloud\-native, and Headless) and composable commerce strategies.
* Design robust data flows and integrations between digital storefronts, Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), OMS (Order Management), PIM, and ERPs.
* Project Delivery \& Technical Leadership
* Serve as the primary architectural leader on large\-scale enterprise e\-commerce implementations, guiding technical teams from discovery and blueprinting through deployment and post\-go\-live stabilization.
* Oversee the technical delivery of multi\-disciplinary squads (onshore and offshore), ensuring adherence to coding standards, security protocols, and CI/CD best practices.
* Mitigate technical risks and resolve complex integration or performance bottlenecks during peak traffic events.
* Stakeholder Management \& Pre\-Sales Support
* Act as a strategic advisor to C\-level executives, business stakeholders, and product owners, translating complex technical architectures into measurable business value.
* Lead architecture workshops, discovery sessions, and vendor evaluations (RFP/RFI processes).
* Estimate technical scope, resource requirements, and timelines for complex cross\-platform initiatives.


**Required Experience \& Qualifications**
* Overall Experience: Minimum of 13 to 15 years of progressive IT experience in software engineering, technical consulting, and enterprise system architecture.
* E\-Commerce Portfolio (Mandatory): Must have hands\-on architectural experience delivering at least 3 to 4 large\-scale, enterprise\-level E\-commerce projects (e.g., multi\-country rollouts, high\-volume transactional sites, complex B2B/B2C marketplace implementations).
* Multi\-Platform Expertise: Deep architectural knowledge in at least two of the following pillars, with working knowledge of the third:
* E\-commerce: SAP Commerce Cloud, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce (Magento), or Composable platforms (commercetools, Spryker).
* CRM: Salesforce (Sales/Service Cloud), Microsoft Dynamics 365, or SAP CX.
* CMS/DXP: Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Sitecore, Contentful, or Contentstack.


 Technical Skills
   

  

* Integration Patterns: Extensive experience designing event\-driven architectures and API gateways using middleware/iPaaS tools (MuleSoft, Dell Boomi, Kafka, or cloud\-native Pub/Sub).
* Cloud Platforms: Strong proficiency in architecting scalable infrastructure on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Microservices \& Web Tech: Familiarity with modern front\-end frameworks (React, Angular, Vue) used in headless setups, alongside backend microservices (Java, Node.js, or .NET).
* Data \& Security: Proven capability in designing secure systems compliant with GDPR/CCPA, integrating single sign\-on (SSO/IAM), and managing distributed data architectures.


 Soft Skills
   

  

* Exceptional consultative skills with a track record of managing client expectations and steering digital strategy.
* High emotional intelligence and the ability to mentor Technical Leads and Senior Developers.
* Excellent presentation and white\-boarding skills.


 Education
   

  

 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
   

  

 If you know some of this even better
   

  

 TOGAF, AWS/Azure Solutions Architect Professional, or platform\-specific architect certifications (e.g., Salesforce B2C Commerce Architect, Sitecore Certified, etc.).
   

  

 What we can offer you
   

  

 Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.
   

  

 Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact\-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.
   

  

 We lead with
 **Heart** 
 , fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human\-centric work flourish.
   

  

 We empower your
 **Brains** 
 for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.
   

  

 And we champion
 **Courage** 
 , inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than yesterday.
   

  

 AT VML Enterprise Solutions
   

  

 Our Enterprise Solutions division houses strategic consultants, creative and technical architects and skilled developers and operators that together help some of the world’s leading organisations to deliver outstanding digital experiences across all major routes to market worldwide: marketplaces, online retailers, D2C, B2B and social platforms. With over 4,200 experts in 55 operational centres across 34 countries, our capabilities span the entire buying journey from customer acquisition, through engagement, to conversion and loyalty, driving multi\-channel growth for world\-leading brands.
   

  

 We work with some of the most exciting brands such as The Coca\-Cola Company, EY, Bosch, Unilever, Ford, DFS, Mercedes\-Benz, Johnson \& Johnson, Nestlé, Sainsbury’s, Selfridges, Shell and Tiffany \& Co. We’ve built over 500 platforms for brands and retailers and generate in excess of $29bn annually for our clients and work with over 50 strategic partners including Adobe, SAP, Salesforce, HCL, Shopify, Sitecore, BigCommerce, commerce tools and Acquia. Our reputation is based on our people, and we believe we have some of the best in the business.
   

  

 As our business grows internationally, we’re looking for new people to join us on our journey to inspire and take a key role in shaping some of the best commerce solutions, services, and websites in the world. Working as a team, no problem is insurmountable; we share in our client’s successes and believe that anyone can show creative bravery no matter what their role is in the team.
   

  

**About WPP**
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world\-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.
   

  

 WPP (VML/WPP Enterprise Solutions) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
   

  

 When you click "Submit Application", this will send any information you add below to WPP (VML/WPP Enterprise Solutions). Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Recruitment Privacy Policy. California residents should read our California Recruitment Privacy Notice. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

8153df96.title: Sr. Technical Program Manager
8153df96.description:
**About the team**
------------------

Zillow's People Technology organization builds and operates the platforms that power how Zillow employees work: Workday, ServiceNow, and the agentic AI layer connecting these systems to the surfaces employees use every day \- Slack, Google Workspace, Zoom, and AI tools. The India engineering team owns this platform stack end to end: production access, change ownership, on\-call rotation, and direct relationships with the business teams we support.
**Zillow Group is a strategic, mission\-driven organization focused on delivering exceptional experiences and measurable outcomes.** Our work spans cross\-functional partnership, scalable programs and operational excellence in support of Zillow’s mission. We bring deep experience working across diverse teams in a dynamic, high\-growth environment, balancing strategic thinking with hands\-on execution to drive meaningful business impact. We are seeking an experienced professional to support our workforce expansion in India.


**About the role**
------------------

As Sr. Technical Program Manager, you are the connective tissue of the PeopleTech delivery model. You own the sprint cadence, the handoff quality gate between Product and Engineering, and the cross\-team coordination that keeps India\-based engineering and US\-based product and business partners in sync. You are a single, senior individual contributor \- not a team of TPMs \- which means you need to be decisive, organized, and confident operating across time zones without a lot of structural backup.


You will work directly with the Product Managers (US\-based) and the India Engineering team, and will be a key voice in how the model matures over time. This is a high\-visibility role in a new operating model that is still being built; you will help define how it works, not just execute inside it.


Responsibilities


* Own sprint execution end to end: create and close sprints in Jira, run grooming and planning, lead standup, track capacity and velocity, and ensure all stories are estimated and complete before each sprint closes.
* Serve as the handoff quality gate between Product and Engineering: review stories for build readiness before sprint commitment, flag ambiguity or missing technical context, and resolve open requirements questions in partnership with PM and Engineering before work begins.
* Own the US\-India coordination bridge: run a daily touchpoint with the PM to carry blocker and handoff status, facilitate the overlap\-window ceremonies (grooming, sprint planning, sprint demo) where PM and Engineering both need to be present, and maintain async\-first practices that keep live meeting load low.
* Manage cross\-team dependencies and risks: identify sequencing issues and resource constraints early, route blockers to the right owner (Engineering or PM), and escalate to leadership when something threatens delivery.
* Coordinate Unit Test logistics: manage test resources, defect tracking, and the communication between Engineering and the PM during unit testing cycles.
* Document the team's operational model: post\-launch on\-call and support structure, escalation paths, and the handoff from project delivery into business\-as\-usual operations.
* Drive continuous improvement: use retrospective findings to sharpen handoff processes, story quality, and sprint predictability over time; build and share repeatable practices that improve how the team works.
* Apply AI tools to program work: status synthesis, risk and dependency tracking, meeting notes and follow\-ups, draft communications \- and help the broader team build that fluency.

This role has been categorized as an Office position. “Office” employees regularly work at the Zillow India office for approximately 80 to 100 percent of their time each month. Employees must live within a reasonable commuting distance of the office. Zillow has not defined a reasonable distance, and expects employees will use judgment in determining this for themselves and understand the implications re: time commitment and cost of daily commute.
In addition to a competitive base pay, employees in this role are eligible for incentive compensation subject to applicable laws and relevant Zillow policies. Actual amounts will vary depending on experience, performance and location.
**Who you are**
---------------

* 5\-8 years of technical program or project/scrum team management experience delivering complex, cross\-functional programs in enterprise SaaS or platform environments.
* Demonstrated ownership of programs spanning multiple teams end to end, including programs where you defined scope and goals yourself in ambiguous conditions.
* Strong technical fluency: you can understand and explain how Workday, ServiceNow, or comparable enterprise platforms fit together, reason about integration dependencies, and assess whether a user story is ready to build \- without needing to write the code yourself.
* Demonstrated working knowledge of Workday HCM or ServiceNow (module configuration, integrations, annual HR cycles, security model basics).
* Experience operating in a distributed or offshore/nearshore engineering model, with US\-based product and business partners \- you understand how to design for async\-first collaboration and how to use overlap hours well.
* Best\-in\-class Jira and sprint management skills: you run ceremonies cleanly, keep the board accurate, and produce sprint summaries that give leadership a clear picture without requiring a meeting.
* Strong communication across technical and non\-technical audiences, including senior executives \- you know what altitude is right for each conversation.
* Track record of influencing without authority, resolving blockers, and driving cross\-org alignment on decisions.
* Fluent with AI tools for program management and able to help others build that fluency.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, IT, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Get to know us**
------------------

At Zillow, we’re reimagining how people move—through the real estate market and through their careers.


As the most\-visited real estate platform in the U.S., Zillow helps millions of customers navigate buying, selling, financing, and renting with greater ease and confidence. Our teams in India play a critical role in building and scaling the technology, products, and operations that power this experience.


Whether you’re working in tech, operations, or shared services, you’ll collaborate with global partners to solve meaningful problems and help more people make home a reality.


Zillow is honored to be recognized among the best workplaces in the U.S.. Zillow was named one of FORTUNE 100 Best Companies to Work For® in 2025, and included on the PEOPLE Companies That Care® 2025 list, reflecting our commitment to creating an innovative, inclusive, and engaging culture where employees are empowered to grow.


No matter where you sit in the organization, your work will help drive innovation, support our customers, and move the industry—and your career—forward, together.


*Zillow Group is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering an inclusive, innovative environment with the best employees. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender, maternity status, HIV status, or veteran status. Reasonable accommodations will be provided to candidates with disabilities, in accordance with applicable policies.*

b0f17a76.title: ASIC Program Manager
b0f17a76.description:
**About Us**
 Anthriq is a signal processing infrastructure company. We build the full acquisition and compute stack for human\-aware technology — from custom analog front\-end IP that captures biosignals at the source, to signal\-first compute systems.
   

  

**Anthriq Silicon** 
 is our ground\-up effort to build a new compute category.
   

  

 Read more about the Anthriq Silicon Program here:
 **anthriq.com/silicon**
**About The Role**
 We are taking our first custom ASIC — a multi\-core vector processor with a purpose\-built instruction set — from architecture to qualified production silicon on an advanced process node.
   

  

 A program like this has two kinds of gravity. Inside, several engineering tracks move at different speeds and depend on each other in ways that are rarely written down. Outside, a set of partners, IP providers, and manufacturing stakeholders all have their own schedules, and none of them are ours to control. Tapeout happens when both of those are held together by someone whose full\-time job it is.
   

  

 That is this role. You will own the master schedule, the dependency map across every internal and external commitment, design freeze and change control, the review cadence, and deliverable acceptance at each milestone.
   

  

 What makes this worth doing: there is one silicon program at this company, and it is this one. You will not be one of nine TPMs reporting into a program office. You will work directly with the founders and the architecture team; you will be in the room where scope and schedule get decided rather than briefed afterward, and your read on what is real versus what is optimistic will move dates that matter.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Own the integrated program plan**
* Maintain one master plan spanning the internal engineering tracks — RTL design, verification, firmware and pre\-silicon software, IP integration, physical implementation and every external delivery the program depends on, through tapeout, NPI and qualification.
* Track the critical path weekly and plan backwards from the dates that cannot move, not forwards from what teams would prefer.


**Run the cadence and break cross\-team blockers**
* Run the weekly program review and milestone reviews from a single source of truth.
* Find the coupling points before they bite: a coverage\-closure slip gating a design freeze, an incomplete register map stalling firmware, a late IP handover holding up integration, a constraints package that will not survive synthesis. Drive these across team leads rather than reporting them after the fact.
* Hold every track to a shared definition of done, and keep interfaces between teams written down rather than assumed.


**Own the dependency map**
* Track every commitment the program rests on with a date, an owner, and an acceptance bar: design deliverables, timing constraints and power intent, third\-party IP delivery including licensing and documentation, emulation and virtual platform builds, package and test specifications, coverage and quality targets, register maps, and milestone approvals.
* Chase every line, and flag slippage weeks ahead rather than at the review.


**Run freeze and change control**
* Own the design freeze gates and the ECO log, keeping late change inside agreed limits.
* Route every proposed change through a documented decision — cost, schedule impact, approval. Nothing enters a frozen baseline silently.


**Manage external delivery**
* Be the program's point of contact for vendors, IP providers, EDA partners and manufacturing\-side stakeholders whose timelines we depend on.
* Track what was committed against what has arrived, and read technical status reporting critically rather than accepting the summary slide.
* Know what evidence each milestone requires before it is accepted, and assemble it.


**Manage risk and report it straight**
* Maintain a live risk register with real mitigations and named owners, and drive contingency planning on tapeout\-critical paths.
* Publish a weekly status — schedule, risks, decisions needed, dependencies missed — and escalate to CTO/CEO with a recommendation attached, not just a problem.
* Flag where timelines are at risk from team bandwidth gaps, and feed that into resourcing and hiring conversations.


**Requirements**
* 8–12 years in semiconductor product development, including 3\+ years in a technical program or project management role on SoC/ASIC programs.
* At least one SoC taken from RTL to tapeout, ideally through silicon bring\-up. Non\-negotiable.
* Working technical fluency across the ASIC lifecycle — design freeze, coverage closure, DFT insertion, synthesis, P\&R, STA, EM/IR, DRC/LVS, netlist drops and ECO classes. You will not be hands\-on in any one discipline, but you will not be a relay either: you need to ask the next question and know when an estimate is soft.
* Experience holding external partners — design services, foundry, OSAT, IP vendors — to your dates, not just attending their status calls.
* Track record running multi\-team programs with competing priorities and a hard external deadline.
* Strong written communication. A large part of this job is a status note clear enough that engineering leads trust it and nobody rewrites it.
* Comfortable with incomplete information, and willing to own the uncomfortable conversation: a slipped date, a thin report, bad news delivered early.
* B.E./B.Tech in Electronics, Electrical, Computer Science or related field.


**Preferred**
* Prior time at a fabless semiconductor company or chip startup, through a tapeout cycle.
* Advanced\-node exposure (7nm or below).
* Third\-party IP licensing and delivery coordination.
* Familiarity with hardware emulation and virtual prototyping platforms.
* Contract\-linked delivery: SOWs, acceptance criteria tied to technical deliverables.
* PMP/PgMP is a plus, but not a substitute for having run a real program.

c5fbfbba.title: Domain Pre Sales AP
c5fbfbba.description:
**FICO (NYSE: FICO)** 
 is a leading global analytics software company, helping businesses in 100\+ countries make better decisions. Join our world\-class team today and fulfill your career potential!
   

  

**The Opportunity**
 As a Business Partner in our Domain Risk Pre\-Sales unit, you'll identify and cultivate new opportunities related to credit and fraud risk, combining deep business knowledge across both domains with a consultative, solutions\-based approach to selling. This role focuses on building new revenue streams through the expansion of FICO Platform capabilities, working closely with the Asia Pacific sales team to translate client business challenges into compelling and credible solutions.
   

  

**What You’ll Contribute**
* Partner with clients on discovery and scoping sessions to uncover business challenges and growth opportunities, then develop proposals and business cases that demonstrate value.
* Contribute to client account plans and lead deal structuring and negotiations, working with internal teams to shape and position solutions that protect existing business and win new deals.
* Contribute to go\-to\-market strategy and market sizing, tracking industry trends and maintaining a strong grasp of our products and the competitive landscape.
* Support innovation workshops, quarterly business reviews, and PoC/PoV engagements, acting as a credit and fraud risk subject matter expert for financial services, insurance, retail, and telecommunications clients.
* Apply your knowledge of the risk management lifecycle, including originations, customer management, fraud, collections, and digital transformation, to build platform demos with Key Account Managers, Solution Sales Executives, and Platform Presales teams.
* Develop strategic plans, proposals, business cases, and executive presentations, tailoring content for audiences ranging from technical teams to C\-level executives.
* Build FICO Platform brand awareness and thought leadership through social media, case studies, blogs, white papers, webinars, and event presentations.
* Up to 50% travel across the region.


**What We’re Seeking**
* Exceptional executive\-level communication and presentation skills, with a proven ability to engage C\-suite stakeholders, boards, and senior leadership, translating complex business insights and technical detail into business impact, ROI, and actionable strategy across strategic planning documents, proposals, and business cases.
* Experience in credit and/or fraud risk management, with a proven track record of achieving meaningful loss reduction and/or customer experience improvements, complemented by sales experience as a vendor and demonstrated project leadership and results orientation.
* Comprehensive understanding of the risk management lifecycle across the entire customer journey, with senior\-level expertise across multiple credit and fraud risk domains including originations, transactional/payment fraud, online/mobile banking fraud, application fraud, first party fraud, customer management, and collections.
* Extensive experience working with payment processors, payment gateways, payment networks, issuers, and acquirers, including authorization flows, real\-time decisioning, and processor, gateway, and network\-specific operating models.
* End\-user knowledge of credit and fraud risk management solutions, authorization systems, authentication solutions, loan origination systems, and other decision management platforms.
* Bachelor's degree in business, analytics, data science, or a related field of study, or equivalent experience.


**Our Offer to You**
* An inclusive culture strongly reflecting our core values: Act Like an Owner, Delight Our Customers and Earn the Respect of Others.
* The opportunity to make an impact and develop professionally by leveraging your unique strengths and participating in valuable learning experiences.
* Highly competitive compensation, benefits and rewards programs that encourage you to bring your best every day and be recognized for doing so.
* An engaging, people\-first work environment offering work/life balance, employee resource groups, and social events to promote interaction and camaraderie.


**Why Make a Move to FICO?**
 At FICO, you can develop your career with a leading organization in one of the fastest\-growing fields in technology today – Big Data analytics. You’ll play a part in our commitment to help businesses use data to improve every choice they make, using advances in artificial intelligence, machine learning, optimization, and much more.
   

  

 FICO makes a real difference in the way businesses operate worldwide:
   

  

* Credit Scoring — FICO® Scores are used by 90 of the top 100 US lenders.
* Fraud Detection and Security — 4 billion payment cards globally are protected by FICO fraud systems.
* Lending — 3/4 of US mortgages are approved using the FICO Score.


 Global trends toward digital transformation have created tremendous demand for FICO’s solutions, placing us among the world’s top 100 software companies by revenue. We help many of the world’s largest banks, insurers, retailers, telecommunications providers and other firms reach a new level of success. Our success is dependent on really talented people – just like you – who thrive on the collaboration and innovation that’s nurtured by a diverse and inclusive environment. We’ll provide the support you need, while ensuring you have the freedom to develop your skills and grow your career. Join FICO and help change the way business thinks!
   

  

 Learn more about how you can fulfil your potential at www.fico.com/Careers
   

  

 FICO promotes a culture of inclusion and seeks to attract a diverse set of candidates for each job opportunity. We are an equal employment opportunity employer and we’re proud to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all candidates without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, pregnancy, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Research has shown that women and candidates from underrepresented communities may not apply for an opportunity if they don’t meet all stated qualifications. While our qualifications are clearly related to role success, each candidate’s profile is unique and strengths in certain skill and/or experience areas can be equally effective. If you believe you have many, but not necessarily all, of the stated qualifications we encourage you to apply.

33e91854.title: Technical Architect - VOIS
33e91854.description:
**Who We Are**
 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology \& Transformation.
   

  

 As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next\-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry\-first model which brings together the best of in\-house and 3rd party capability.
   

  

 We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
   

  

 \#VOIS \#BeUnrivalled \#CreateTheFuture
   

  

**About This Role**
 We are seeking an experienced Technical Architect to lead end\-to\-end solution architecture for Vodafone Business USD Domain digital platforms and portal services. This role is responsible for defining scalable, secure, and maintainable architectures while supporting Vodafone’s digital transformation journey. The successful candidate will work across application, integration, workflow, data, and infrastructure layers, ensuring high\-quality delivery within agreed timelines. They will collaborate with cross\-functional stakeholders, provide architectural leadership, and drive modern engineering practices across enterprise\-scale systems.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
 Define end\-to\-end solution architecture for enterprise applications, digital platforms, and microservices\-based systems.
   

  

* Translate business requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable technical solutions
* Drive architectural decisions across application, integration, workflow, data, and infrastructure domains
* Produce high\-level and low\-level design documents, architecture diagrams, integration designs, and deployment models
* Ensure alignment with enterprise architecture, security, compliance, and operational standards
* Define API standards, service decomposition strategies, configuration approaches, resiliency patterns, and deployment models
* Ensure solutions meet scalability, performance, availability, and reliability requirements
* Review technical designs and code to ensure adherence to architectural standards and engineering best practices
* Design and implement event\-driven solutions using Apache Kafka
* Define topic structures, partitioning strategies, schema governance, retry mechanisms, and consumer group design
* Promote best practices for asynchronous communication, event streaming, monitoring, tracing, idempotency, and message ordering
* Design workflow\-driven solutions using Camunda and/or Temporal
* Establish orchestration patterns for long\-running business processes, compensation mechanisms, retries, and state management
* Collaborate with business and engineering teams to optimise process automation and workflow delivery
* Define data architecture and persistence strategies using MongoDB and relevant enterprise data platforms
* Establish standards for schema design, indexing, performance tuning, lifecycle management, and high availability
* Ensure data resilience, consistency, and operational efficiency across distributed systems
* Define observability and logging standards for enterprise applications
* Drive implementation of structured logging, distributed tracing, metrics, correlation IDs, and alerting mechanisms
* Support operational excellence through proactive monitoring and production readiness practices
* Provide guidance and technical leadership across architecture, development, testing, and production support functions
* Conduct architecture reviews, design walkthroughs, and governance assessments
* Mentor engineering teams and support capability development across the organisation
* Collaborate closely with product, delivery, operations, infrastructure, and security teams
* Ensure secure\-by\-design principles covering authentication, authorisation, encryption, and auditability
* Embed performance, resilience, disaster recovery, and operational readiness into architecture decisions
* Support DevSecOps practices, CI/CD adoption, and deployment automation
* Participate in design reviews, risk assessments, and compliance activities.s


**Experience**
**Who you are**
* 10\+ years of experience in software engineering and solution design
* 5\+ years of experience architecting or leading design of microservices\-based distributed systems
* Strong experience working within large\-scale enterprise environments supporting critical business applications
* Experience in modernisation, transformation, or migration initiatives


 Technical Expertise
   

  

* Strong hands\-on experience with Java and Spring Boot for microservices and REST API development
* Proven expertise in Apache Kafka and event\-driven architecture patterns
* Strong knowledge of logging frameworks including SLF4J, Logback, and Log4j2
* Solid MongoDB experience including schema design, indexing, performance optimisation, and operational management
* Hands\-on experience with workflow orchestration platforms such as Camunda and/or Temporal
* Strong understanding of distributed systems, API design, and enterprise integration patterns
* Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, OpenShift, or comparable cloud\-native platforms
* Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines, version control systems, and deployment automation
* Exposure to observability and monitoring platforms such as Datadog, Dynatrace, Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, or Splunk

dce4481b.title: Azure Architect – FTE or C-H
dce4481b.description:
For 20\- plus years Centroid has helped complex companies accelerate their digital transformation by implementing and managing Cloud\-based business solutions. We specialize in advisory, deployment, migration, integration and managed services. Our goal is to provide superior service to our clients while providing our employees with continued growth and success.
   

  

**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time, or C\-H
   

  

**Location:** 
 Remote
   

  

**Technical Skills and Knowledge:**
* Deep Understanding of Azure Services: A comprehensive grasp of Azure's core services across compute (Virtual Machines, Azure Functions, Azure Container Instances, Azure Kubernetes Service), networking (Virtual Networks, Load Balancers, Azure DNS, VPN Gateway), storage (Blob Storage, Azure Files, Azure Queue Storage, Azure Disks), and databases (Azure SQL Database, Azure Cosmos DB, Azure Database for MySQL/PostgreSQL). Skills that are strongly preferred include: Azure VMware Solution (AVS) and VMware HCX,
* Azure Architecture and Design: Ability to design scalable, secure, highly available, and cost\-effective cloud solutions on Azure, aligning with the Azure Well\-Architected Framework and Cloud Adoption Framework.
* Identity and Access Management: Expertise in Azure Active Directory (Azure AD), including user and group management, role\-based access control (RBAC), single sign\-on (SSO), multi\-factor authentication (MFA), and conditional access.
* Business Continuity and Disaster Recovery (BCDR): Ability to design and implement BCDR solutions using Azure Backup, Azure Site Recovery, and other relevant services.
* Monitoring and Logging: Experience with Azure Monitor, Azure Log Analytics, and Application Insights for monitoring the health, performance, and security of Azure environments.
* Cost Management: Ability to optimize Azure spending and implement cost control measures.


**Experience:**
* Significant Cloud Experience: Looking for someone with 5\-10 years of overall cloud experience, with a focus on Azure native cloud services.
* Hands\-on Azure Experience: Proven experience in designing, deploying, and managing Azure solutions is crucial. This includes working with various Azure services and implementing architectural best practices.
* Experience with Migration: Familiarity with migrating applications and workloads from on\-premises environments to Azure is often required.


**Soft Skills:**
* Communication Skills: Excellent verbal and written communication skills are essential for explaining technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders, including C\-suite executives.
* Problem\-Solving Skills: Ability to identify and resolve complex technical issues in Azure environments.
* Analytical Skills: Capacity to analyze business requirements and translate them into effective Azure solutions.
* Collaboration Skills: Working effectively with cross\-functional teams, including developers, administrators, and security.

14e02865.title: Cloud Operations Engineer - Technology R&D
14e02865.description:
**About Signant Health**
 At Signant Health, we help bring life\-changing treatments to patients faster. We are a global evidence generation company that supports clinical trials with smart technology, scientific expertise, and hands\-on operational support — so better data leads to better decisions in healthcare. We embrace AI and advanced technologies to enhance every aspect of what we do, from data analysis to operational efficiency.
   

  

 Our teams work at the intersection of science, technology, and patient experience, delivering digital solutions powered by AI innovation that make clinical trials more efficient, more accurate, and more accessible around the world. Trusted by leading pharmaceutical companies and CROs, our platforms and services support studies across more than 90 countries and have contributed to hundreds of new drug approvals.
   

  

 If you are motivated by meaningful work, global impact, and innovation in clinical research and digital health — including the opportunity to work with cutting\-edge AI technologies — you will find purpose and opportunity at Signant Health.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As a member of Cloud Operations team at Signant Health, the Cloud Operations Engineer will collaborate with development, release, and application teams to install, configure, deploy and manage infrastructure, application components and services in customer environments to ensure they are highly available, scalable and sustainable. You will also work with Apps Integration and the DevOps teams to identify and resolve issues and improve the overall Support Process.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Automation for tasks like deployment of servers and application software across environment, alerts via scripting.
* Troubleshoot to identify root cause and work towards faster work\-arounds and resolution of reported issues
* Quickly \& effectively utilize existing tools and utilities to improve troubleshooting process in the long run
* Ensure the stability and availability of Application operation components running on Public Clouds.
* Participate in 24x7 on\-call rotation to support production environments and shift work.
* Control infrastructure costs by continually looking for opportunities to right\-size servers and services
* Migrate on\-premises workloads to the cloud (AWS/Azure)
* Respond to alerts of application instability, identifying root cause and corrective actions.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* BS degree in Computer Science or related discipline
* At least 3 years experience in a modern software development environment that is Agile and incorporates DevOps practices. Hands on experience with DevOps Tools like Jenkins, Artifactory, Maven, Git, BitBucket, TFS
* Experience with cloud platforms like AWS and Azure; experience in Python, Terraform, PowerShell
* Experience in containerization and orchestration (kubernetes) and configuration management using Ansible
* Experience with Continuous Integration and Continuous Deployment
* Hands\-on experience in Linux/Windows server operating systems, and Web Server technologies including IIS, Tomcat, WebLogic, WebSphere and Apache Web Server
* Knowledge of relational databases including SQL Server, Oracle, Postgres or MySQL
* Proven ability to work in a team\-oriented environment, providing back\-up support to team members \& establishing/maintaining effective work relationships with co\-workers within and across functional areas.
* Experience setting up and configuring monitoring systems.
* Ability to work independently.


**Desired Qualifications**
* 5\+ years experience in a modern software development environment that is Agile and incorporates DevOps practices
* Experience migrating on\-premises workloads to the cloud (AWS/Azure)
* Hands\-on experience with enterprise web server technologies such as WebLogic and WebSphere
* Availability to participate in a 24x7 on\-call rotation and shift work to support production environments
* Willingness to undertake international or domestic travel on a need base


**Why Signant Health?**
 At Signant Health, your work has real impact. Everything we build, support, and deliver helps advance clinical research and bring new treatments to patients faster — improving lives around the world. Our teams combine science, technology, and operational expertise to solve complex clinical trial challenges, and every role contributes to that mission.
   

  

 We offer a collaborative, global environment where you can grow your career while working alongside experts across clinical, technology, data, and operations, with opportunities to learn, take ownership, and drive meaningful innovation — not just maintain the status quo.
   

  

 If you are looking for purpose\-driven work, smart colleagues, and the opportunity to help shape the future of clinical research and digital health, Signant Health is the place to do it.
   

  

 At Signant Health, accepting difference isn't enough — we celebrate it, we support it, and we nurture it for the benefit of our team members, our clients, and our community. We are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and an affirmative action employer, committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, or veteran status. Prior to their start date, all new hires are required to be verified through a thorough background check and identity verification to confirm eligibility for employment.
   

  

 Unsolicited resumes submitted by agencies or third\-party recruiters directly to hiring managers or any Signant Health employee will not be considered and will not obligate Signant Health to any fees or terms associated with the submission.

**Overview:**

In this role, you will lead the technical strategy and end\-to\-end architecture design for transformative deals—specifically integrating SD\-WAN, Enterprise Ethernet / Connectivity. **Solution Architecture \& Design:** Author comprehensive High\-Level Designs (HLD), Bill of Materials (BOM), and Statements of Work (SOW) spanning core networking, cloud connectivity, and managed services.
  
**Portfolio Integration:** Architect integrated solutions combining:
  
**SD\-WAN \& SASE:** Cisco SD\-WAN (Viptela), Fortinet, Versa, or VMware SD\-WAN (Velocloud) overlay architectures with integrated security features.
  
**Ethernet \& Transport:** BT Wholesale/Openreach Ethernet services, E\-Line/E\-LAN, Direct Internet Access (DIA), Wavelengths, and MEF\-compliant carrier connectivity.
  
**Commercial \& Bid Support:** Collaborate with BT Bid Management and Commercial Pricing teams to ensure solution feasibility, SLA compliance, margin optimization, and competitive positioning against major MSPs/telecoms.
  
**Proof of Concept (PoC):** Define PoC success criteria, lead technical demonstrations, and validate complex WAN\-to\-cloud failover and performance scenarios for prospective clients.
  
**Governance \& Handover:** Ensure all designs pass internal BT technical governance reviews and lead seamless transition handovers from Pre\-Sales to Engineering and Delivery teams.

6e61c9f6.title: Lead Solution Architect
6e61c9f6.description:
**Who We Are**
 WPP Enterprise Solutions designs, builds, and operates the growth systems that competitive businesses rely on. In a world where Al is reshaping how companies drive growth, we lead clients in business transformation and marketing modernization, connecting strategy directly to execution. Our 12,000 experts in engineering and platforms, commerce, consulting, content transformation, CRM, and CX work within a unified global operating unit across 40\+ markets. WPP Enterprise Solutions works alongside best\-in\-class partners including Adobe, AWS, Braze, Google, Microsoft, Salesforce, and Shopify, as well as innovators in AI, to deliver growth solutions tailored to the needs of our clients’ businesses. VML, part of WPP, supports WPP Enterprise Solutions by helping brands activate transformation through creativity and experience.
   

  

 The opportunity
   

  

 We are seeking a highly seasoned and visionary Lead Solution Architect to drive the digital transformation of our enterprise technology landscape. In this role, you will be the definitive technical authority responsible for designing, integrating, and scaling complex ecosystems that span E\-commerce platforms, Customer Relationship Management (CRM) systems, and Content Management Systems (CMS).
   

  

 You will bridge the gap between business strategy and technical execution, designing modern, cloud\-native, and headless/composable solutions. The ideal candidate brings a wealth of experience in enterprise architecture and a proven portfolio of successfully leading multi\-million\-dollar digital commerce transformations.
   

  

 What you’ll be doing
   

  

* Enterprise Architecture \& Solution Design
* Define and own the end\-to\-end technical architecture for digital platforms, seamlessly integrating E\-commerce engines, CMS (Digital Experience Platforms), and CRM systems.
* Champion modern architectural paradigms, specifically MACH (Microservices, API\-first, Cloud\-native, and Headless) and composable commerce strategies.
* Design robust data flows and integrations between digital storefronts, Customer Data Platforms (CDPs), OMS (Order Management), PIM, and ERPs.
* Project Delivery \& Technical Leadership
* Serve as the primary architectural leader on large\-scale enterprise e\-commerce implementations, guiding technical teams from discovery and blueprinting through deployment and post\-go\-live stabilization.
* Oversee the technical delivery of multi\-disciplinary squads (onshore and offshore), ensuring adherence to coding standards, security protocols, and CI/CD best practices.
* Mitigate technical risks and resolve complex integration or performance bottlenecks during peak traffic events.
* Stakeholder Management \& Pre\-Sales Support
* Act as a strategic advisor to C\-level executives, business stakeholders, and product owners, translating complex technical architectures into measurable business value.
* Lead architecture workshops, discovery sessions, and vendor evaluations (RFP/RFI processes).
* Estimate technical scope, resource requirements, and timelines for complex cross\-platform initiatives.


**Required Experience \& Qualifications**
* Overall Experience: Minimum of 13 to 15 years of progressive IT experience in software engineering, technical consulting, and enterprise system architecture.
* E\-Commerce Portfolio (Mandatory): Must have hands\-on architectural experience delivering at least 3 to 4 large\-scale, enterprise\-level E\-commerce projects (e.g., multi\-country rollouts, high\-volume transactional sites, complex B2B/B2C marketplace implementations).
* Multi\-Platform Expertise: Deep architectural knowledge in at least two of the following pillars, with working knowledge of the third:
* E\-commerce: SAP Commerce Cloud, Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Adobe Commerce (Magento), or Composable platforms (commercetools, Spryker).
* CRM: Salesforce (Sales/Service Cloud), Microsoft Dynamics 365, or SAP CX.
* CMS/DXP: Adobe Experience Manager (AEM), Sitecore, Contentful, or Contentstack.


 Technical Skills
   

  

* Integration Patterns: Extensive experience designing event\-driven architectures and API gateways using middleware/iPaaS tools (MuleSoft, Dell Boomi, Kafka, or cloud\-native Pub/Sub).
* Cloud Platforms: Strong proficiency in architecting scalable infrastructure on AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
* Microservices \& Web Tech: Familiarity with modern front\-end frameworks (React, Angular, Vue) used in headless setups, alongside backend microservices (Java, Node.js, or .NET).
* Data \& Security: Proven capability in designing secure systems compliant with GDPR/CCPA, integrating single sign\-on (SSO/IAM), and managing distributed data architectures.


 Soft Skills
   

  

* Exceptional consultative skills with a track record of managing client expectations and steering digital strategy.
* High emotional intelligence and the ability to mentor Technical Leads and Senior Developers.
* Excellent presentation and white\-boarding skills.


 Education
   

  

 Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.
   

  

 If you know some of this even better
   

  

 TOGAF, AWS/Azure Solutions Architect Professional, or platform\-specific architect certifications (e.g., Salesforce B2C Commerce Architect, Sitecore Certified, etc.).
   

  

 What we can offer you
   

  

 Alongside the opportunity to work with some of the most exciting brands around the world, we’ll also prioritise your career development and help you grow your skills. We’ll empower you to make a difference, allow you to be yourself, and respect who you are.
   

  

 Our culture thrives on our core values, designed for impact\-driven individuals: Heart, Brains and Courage.
   

  

 We lead with
 **Heart** 
 , fostering empathy and trust where genuine connections and human\-centric work flourish.
   

  

 We empower your
 **Brains** 
 for innovation, valuing relentless curiosity and collaborative intelligence to solve complex challenges.
   

  

 And we champion
 **Courage** 
 , inspiring you to speak up, embrace experimentation, and advocate for bold solutions that push our thinking to be better than yesterday.
   

  

 AT VML Enterprise Solutions
   

  

 Our Enterprise Solutions division houses strategic consultants, creative and technical architects and skilled developers and operators that together help some of the world’s leading organisations to deliver outstanding digital experiences across all major routes to market worldwide: marketplaces, online retailers, D2C, B2B and social platforms. With over 4,200 experts in 55 operational centres across 34 countries, our capabilities span the entire buying journey from customer acquisition, through engagement, to conversion and loyalty, driving multi\-channel growth for world\-leading brands.
   

  

 We work with some of the most exciting brands such as The Coca\-Cola Company, EY, Bosch, Unilever, Ford, DFS, Mercedes\-Benz, Johnson \& Johnson, Nestlé, Sainsbury’s, Selfridges, Shell and Tiffany \& Co. We’ve built over 500 platforms for brands and retailers and generate in excess of $29bn annually for our clients and work with over 50 strategic partners including Adobe, SAP, Salesforce, HCL, Shopify, Sitecore, BigCommerce, commerce tools and Acquia. Our reputation is based on our people, and we believe we have some of the best in the business.
   

  

 As our business grows internationally, we’re looking for new people to join us on our journey to inspire and take a key role in shaping some of the best commerce solutions, services, and websites in the world. Working as a team, no problem is insurmountable; we share in our client’s successes and believe that anyone can show creative bravery no matter what their role is in the team.
   

  

**About WPP**
 WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence and world\-class partnerships – all united by our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth. For more information, visit WPP.com.
   

  

 WPP (VML/WPP Enterprise Solutions) is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
   

  

 When you click "Submit Application", this will send any information you add below to WPP (VML/WPP Enterprise Solutions). Before you do this, we think it's a good idea to read through our Recruitment Privacy Policy. California residents should read our California Recruitment Privacy Notice. This explains what we do with your personal data when you apply for a role with us, and, how you can update the information you have provided us with or how to remove it.

d3340dc9.title: ServiceNow Solutions Manager (Pre-Sales)
d3340dc9.description:
Overview:

Prodapt is seeking a ServiceNow Solutions Manager to be based in one of our India offices. You'll shape ServiceNow\-based, AI\-led solutions spanning our workflows \- combining deep telecom\-native (TMT) expertise with our agentic AI capabilities, and extending this solutioning approach to adjacent, non\-telco industries as Prodapt's portfolio grows \- that power our sales, alliances, and product development initiatives. The role is focused on architecting proposals, and providing technical solutioning during the sales cycle, with a strong emphasis on applying AI and agentic AI methodologies to ServiceNow solution design. This role requires 8\-10 years of relevant ServiceNow experience, hands\-on exposure to AI\-led solution design, and strong pre\-sales solutioning skills
Responsibilities:
* Partner with sales and alliances teams to architect ServiceNow\-based, AI\-led solutions across the entire TMT stack and adjacent non\-telco industries for prospective deals, RFPs, and RFIs
* Provide pre\-sales technical guidance across the Now Platform, including designing AI and agentic AI\-based methodologies to support deal qualification and positioning
* Deliver solution proposals, demonstrations, proof\-of\-concepts, and technical presentations spotlighting Prodapt's agentic AI stack to prospects, partners, and internal stakeholders across telecom and other industry verticals
* Partner with the CTO Office to stay current on the ServiceNow platform roadmap, translating new capabilities into sales\-ready solution narratives for TMT and non\-telco engagements alike
* Support competitive positioning, scoping, and pricing inputs during the sales cycle
* Act as the technical point of contact between sales, alliances, and product teams during the pre\-sales phase, handing off solution designs\- to delivery teams, post\-sale
* Contribute to building reusable ServiceNow solution accelerators, reference architectures, and best practices that can be applied across TMT and non\-telco industry verticals


Requirements:
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, information systems, or engineering
* 8\-10\+ years of ServiceNow experience, with a solid pre\-sales /solutioning background
* Familiarity with telecom\-specific ServiceNow modules (TMT) and TM Forum/MEF\-aligned solutions, along with the versatility to extend ServiceNow AI\-led solutioning approaches to non\-telco industries (media, technology, and other enterprise verticals)
* Hands\-on experience applying AI/GenAI solution design methodologies \- agentic workflow design, prompt engineering, and use\-case discovery \- to ServiceNow solutioning, along with a working understanding of how AI responses are grounded in enterprise data
* Hands\-on working knowledge of ServiceNow's agentic AI stack \- Now Assist, AI Agent Studio, Context Engine, AI Control Tower, RaptorDB Pro, and Now Platform SDK/Build Agent \- with the ability to design, configure, and demo solutions built on these capabilities
* ServiceNow certifications – CSA, CIS and/or CTA are preferred
* Strong presentation and demo skills; ability to translate technical capabilities into business value for prospects and stakeholders
* Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to work directly with CTO Office, sales, product and alliances leadership
* Telecom/communications industry domain experience is a must, with the ability to design and position ServiceNow AI\-led solutions for non\-telco industries as well
* Based in one of Prodapt's India offices

e1fd39bf.description:
Some careers shine brighter than others.
   

  

 If you’re looking for a career that will help you stand out, join HSBC and fulfil your potential. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
   

  

 HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.
   

  

 We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Consultant Specialist
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Develop and manage project strategies, securing stakeholder engagement for project plans, commitments, and modifications.
* Assist technology teams in managing delivery by balancing scope, schedule, resources, dependencies, communication, and budget.
* Collaborate with the technology team and Product Owner to enhance productivity through effective backlog management and Agile methodologies such as Scrum, Kanban, and Lean.
* Oversee and report on progress, issues, dependencies, and risks to programme management and stakeholders, providing recommendations to sustain delivery momentum and benefit realisation.

 To be successful in this role, you should meet the following requirements:

* Strong knowledge of SDLC, Agile (Scrum/Kanban), and hybrid delivery models.
* Knowledge of Avaloq technology (added advantage).
* Ability to manage distributed teams and lead multiple teams through subordinate managers, with accountability for independent budgets.
* Broad understanding of concepts and principles across multiple or rapidly evolving disciplines.
* Advanced understanding of value units, products, regions, and legal entities, including HSBC’s product and service positioning.
* Ability to handle diverse activities requiring complex judgements and solutions, applying strategic vision and analysis; makes decisions within strategic guidelines aligned to long\-term business goals.
* Strong business planning, continuous improvement ownership (end\-to\-end implementation), and high\-level interactive listening, negotiation, and influencing skills.

085c1979.title: Solution Engineer - ITSM
085c1979.description:
At SolarWinds, we’re a people\-first company. Our purpose is to enrich the lives of the people we serve—including our employees, customers, shareholders, partners, and communities. Join us in our mission to help customers accelerate business transformation with simple, powerful, and secure solutions.
 



 The ideal candidate thrives in an innovative, fast\-paced environment and is collaborative, accountable, ready, and empathetic. We’re looking for individuals who believe they can accomplish more as a team and create lasting growth for themselves and others. We hire based on attitude, competency, and commitment. Solarians are ready to advance our world\-class solutions in a fast\-paced environment and accept the challenge to lead with purpose. If you’re looking to build your career with an exceptional team, you’ve come to the right place. Join SolarWinds and grow with us!
 



  
 



 ITSM serves as a trusted technical advisor and partner to the sales organization, helping prospective and existing customers evaluate and adopt SolarWinds IT Service Management solutions, including SolarWinds Service Desk (SWSD) and Web Help Desk (WHD). This role combines technical expertise, business acumen, and strong communication skills to demonstrate how SolarWinds solutions address customer challenges and deliver measurable business value.
 



 The Solution Engineer partners closely with Account Executives, Customer Success, Product Management, and other cross\-functional teams to drive revenue growth, support customer success, and provide market feedback. Success in this role requires a consultative approach, the ability to understand customer business objectives, and the technical skills to architect and demonstrate effective solutions.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Partner with Sales teams throughout the customer lifecycle to support new business, expansion, and renewal opportunities.

954343e3.description:
Responsible for leading the development of comprehensive solution architecture strategies, ensuring seamless integration of application solutions across teams and domains while maintaining robust technical foundations. The role involves collaboration with other architects to validate feasibility, oversee compliance with quality attributes, manage technical risks, and guide IT architects to enhance their solution architecture leadership skills, all while aligning with FedEx best practices and technological standards.
   

  

* Lead and define solution architecture strategies, encompassing technology and architecture for seamless integration of application solutions across various teams and domains.
* Establish and maintain the architectural runway at a solution level, ensuring a robust technical foundation for the rapid and reliable creation of new functionalities and features across teams and ARTs.
* Collaborate with other architects to validate the feasibility and sustainability of solution architectures and application portfolio lifecycle planning, ensuring alignment with FedEx best practices and design standards.
* Oversee the management of non\-functional requirements and compliance to ensure that solution architectures meet essential quality attributes such as performance, scalability, security, and maintainability, meeting stakeholder acceptance criteria.
* Collaborate with other architects to define the appropriate delivery approach for solution services, encompassing processes, methodologies, tooling, and partnerships for agreement on service design and delivery.
* Identify and manage technical risks and continuous improvement opportunities for solution architectures, leveraging expert business knowledge to mitigate risks and capitalize on opportunities.
* Continuously monitor and evaluate new or emerging technologies utilized by internal teams, ensuring alignment with FedEx technological standards and potential integration into solution architectures.
* Provide guidance and mentorship to other IT architects to develop their skills and expertise in solution architecture leadership and execution.


 Education: Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, information systems and/or equivalent formal training or work experience. Relevant Master’s degree, TOGAF certification and SAFe Agile certification strongly preferred.
   

  

 Experience: Eight (8\) years equivalent work experience in information technology or engineering environment with a direct responsibility for strategy formulation and solution/technical architecture, as well as designing, architecting, developing, implementing and monitoring efficient and effective solutions to diverse and complex business problems.
   

  

**Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**
* Fluency in English
* Accuracy \& Attention to Detail
* Influencing \& Persuasion
* Planning \& Organizing
* Problem Solving
* Project Management


**Preferred Qualifications**

 Our Company

We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.
   

  

 Our Philosophy
   

  

 The People\-Service\-Profit philosophy (P\-S\-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People\-Service\-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. Our success in the industry is attributed to our people. Through our P\-S\-P philosophy, we have a work environment that encourages team members to be innovative in delivering the highest possible quality of service to our customers. We care for their well\-being, and value their contributions to the company.
   

  

 Our Culture
   

  

 Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. The FedEx culture and values have been a cornerstone of our success and growth since we began in the early 1970’s. While other companies can copy our systems, infrastructure, and processes, our culture makes us unique and is often a differentiating factor as we compete and grow in today’s global marketplace.
