ad1c332a.description:
**Oracle APEX \& Oracle Fusion Cloud Solutions Architect**

 **About Us:**


**Atlas Systems Inc. is a Software Solutions company headquartered in East Brunswick, NJ. Incorporated in 2003, Atlas provides comprehensive range of solutions in the area of GRC, Technology, Procurement, Healthcare Provider and Oracle to customers across the globe. Combining our unparalleled experience of over a decade in the software industry and global reach, we have grown with extensive capabilities across industry verticals.**



For more information, please visit our website https://www.atlassystems.com/

 **Please click on the link below to apply for this position:**



https://atlas.bamboohr.com/careers/606

 **Job Title: Oracle APEX \& Oracle Fusion Cloud Solutions Architect**


**Location: Bangalore (Work from Office / Hybrid as applicable)**


**Work Timing: IST Hours**


**Experience: 10\+ Years**


**Engagement Type: Long\-term / Multi\-year (Contract / Full\-time)**

 **Position Summary**



We are seeking an experienced Oracle APEX \& Oracle Fusion Cloud Solutions Architect to lead the architecture, design, development, integration, and delivery of a custom Agent Billing platform as part of Project Fusion. The solution will support the calculation, review, approval, reconciliation, and invoicing of monthly agent charges that are not supported natively within Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.



The successful candidate will architect and build a scalable Oracle PaaS\-based application using Oracle APEX, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), Oracle Fusion REST APIs, and Oracle Database technologies. The platform will operate as a billing orchestration and calculation engine tightly integrated with Oracle Fusion Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Projects, Customer, Supplier, and AP/AR Netting processes.



The role requires strong hands\-on Oracle architecture and development expertise, with the ability to translate complex business billing requirements into secure, scalable, maintainable solutions and provide technical leadership from requirements through production implementation.

 **Key Responsibilities**



Solution Architecture \& Business Analysis


* Work with business stakeholders, finance teams, product owners, and Oracle functional teams to understand agent billing processes, business rules, exceptions, approvals, reconciliation requirements, and invoicing scenarios.
* Translate business requirements into end\-to\-end solution architecture, application components, data models, integration flows, security controls, and implementation roadmaps.
* Design the Agent Billing platform as an extension to Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP capabilities without unnecessarily duplicating native Fusion functionality.
* Define functional and technical boundaries between Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle APEX, Oracle Database, OIC, and supporting PaaS services.
* Design scalable architecture capable of supporting monthly billing cycles, high transaction volumes, auditability, traceability, and future business expansion.


**Oracle APEX \& Application Development**


* Design and develop enterprise\-grade applications using Oracle APEX, including user interfaces, interactive reports, dashboards, forms, workflows, validations, and role\-based functionality.
* Build robust calculation and billing orchestration logic for monthly agent charges, including configurable business rules, adjustments, exceptions, approvals, and reconciliation.
* Design reusable APEX components and application patterns following Oracle development and enterprise architecture standards.
* Implement application\-level audit trails, status tracking, exception management, and operational reporting.
* Optimize APEX applications for performance, usability, maintainability, and secure enterprise deployment.


**Oracle Fusion Cloud Integration \& OIC**


* Architect and implement integrations between Oracle APEX and Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP using Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST APIs, and other appropriate Oracle integration mechanisms.
* Integrate with Oracle Fusion Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable, Projects, Customer, Supplier, and AP/AR Netting processes.
* Design reliable integration patterns for data synchronization, transaction creation/update, status retrieval, error handling, retries, reconciliation, and monitoring.
* Develop and maintain OIC integrations, mappings, transformations, orchestration flows, and exception\-handling mechanisms.
* Ensure integration designs are loosely coupled, secure, scalable, observable, and aligned with Oracle Fusion Cloud integration standards.


**Billing, Reconciliation \& Financial Processing**


* Architect the end\-to\-end lifecycle for agent charge calculation, review, approval, reconciliation, and invoicing.
* Design calculation engines and configurable rules to accommodate complex monthly agent billing scenarios not natively supported by Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.
* Design reconciliation processes between the custom billing platform and Oracle Fusion financial transactions.
* Support integration with AR invoicing, AP processing, customer and supplier master data, project\-related transactions, and AP/AR Netting.
* Ensure financial data integrity, transaction traceability, controls, and auditability across the billing lifecycle.


**Database \& Data Architecture**


* Design Oracle Database schemas, data models, tables, views, stored procedures, packages, functions, sequences, indexes, and data access patterns supporting the platform.
* Develop efficient SQL and PL/SQL for billing calculations, data processing, validation, reconciliation, and reporting.
* Define data retention, audit, archival, performance, and data\-quality strategies.
* Optimize database performance and ensure appropriate transaction management and concurrency controls.


**Security, Performance \& Production Readiness**


* Design application and integration security including authentication, authorization, role\-based access, API security, secrets management, and least\-privilege principles.
* Ensure appropriate segregation of duties and access controls for billing preparation, review, approval, reconciliation, and financial processing.
* Define performance, scalability, availability, logging, monitoring, and operational support requirements.
* Lead technical reviews, architecture governance, code reviews, deployment readiness, and production support transition.
* Identify technical risks, integration dependencies, performance bottlenecks, and architectural constraints and drive mitigation plans.


**Delivery \& Technical Leadership**


* Lead the solution through architecture, development, testing, deployment, and stabilization phases.
* Work closely with Oracle functional consultants, developers, QA, integration teams, business stakeholders, and customer IT teams.
* Provide technical guidance and mentoring to APEX, OIC, database, and integration developers.
* Create architecture documents, interface specifications, data models, technical design documents, deployment plans, and operational documentation.
* Promote reusable integration, APEX, database, and Oracle Fusion solution patterns and engineering best practices.


**Innovation \& Continuous Improvement**


* Stay current with Oracle APEX, Oracle Integration Cloud, Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle Database, REST APIs, and Oracle PaaS capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to simplify processes, improve automation, reduce manual reconciliation, and increase billing accuracy.
* Contribute to reusable Oracle accelerators, reference architectures, development standards, and technical best practices.

  


**Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
* 10\+ years of experience in Oracle application development, solution architecture, enterprise application integration, or technology consulting.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Oracle APEX application development and enterprise solution architecture.
* Proven experience designing and implementing Oracle Fusion Cloud integrations, preferably across Financials modules.
* Strong experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST APIs, Oracle Database, SQL, and PL/SQL.
* Experience working with business stakeholders and translating complex financial/business requirements into technical solutions.
* Experience leading technical teams and delivering enterprise applications in production environments.

  


**Technical Skills**



Oracle APEX \& Database


* Oracle APEX, Oracle Database, SQL, PL/SQL, database design, stored procedures, packages, functions, views, triggers, indexing, performance tuning, and data modeling.


**Oracle Fusion Cloud**


* Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Financials, Accounts Receivable (AR), Accounts Payable (AP), Projects, Customer, Supplier, and AP/AR Netting; understanding of Fusion business processes and REST APIs.


**Integration \& APIs**


* Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), REST APIs, JSON/XML, API orchestration, mappings, transformations, error handling, retries, monitoring, and integration security.


**Application Architecture**


* Oracle PaaS architecture, enterprise application architecture, workflow/orchestration, scalable application design, role\-based security, auditability, observability, and production operations.


**Delivery \& Engineering**


* Agile delivery, SDLC, requirements analysis, technical design, code reviews, testing strategy, CI/CD and deployment practices, technical documentation, and production support.

  


**Core Competencies**


* Oracle APEX Solution Architecture
* Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP Integration
* Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC)
* Billing \& Financial Process Architecture
* Oracle Database \& PL/SQL Development
* REST API \& Enterprise Integration
* Business Requirements Analysis
* Application \& Data Architecture
* Security, Performance \& Scalability
* Technical Leadership \& Mentoring
* Stakeholder Management
* Technical Design \& Documentation
* Problem Solving \& Root\-Cause Analysis
* Production Delivery \& Operational Excellence


**Success Measures**


* Successful delivery of a scalable Agent Billing platform supporting calculation, review, approval, reconciliation, and invoicing processes.
* Reliable and secure integration between the custom billing platform and Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP.
* Accurate and auditable billing calculations and reconciliation with Oracle Fusion AR, AP, Projects, Customer, Supplier, and AP/AR Netting processes.
* High\-quality Oracle APEX applications and OIC integrations meeting functional, performance, security, and maintainability standards.
* Successful production implementation with minimal operational disruption and effective support transition.
* Strong stakeholder satisfaction and effective collaboration across business, functional, technical, and delivery teams.
* Contribution to reusable Oracle architecture patterns, accelerators, development standards, and organizational capability development.

fe650c0a.title: Senior Cloud Engineer
fe650c0a.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.


We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!


Job Description


**Position Summary**

the Senior Cloud Engineer focuses on cloud data platforms and integration, reports directly to the FinOps Technical Leader. The Senior Cloud Engineer is responsible for designing, building, and supporting scalable cloud\-based data solutions across Azure and AWS. You will use your experience in Databricks, data transformation, API integration, automation, and cloud\-native technologies. It develops secure, reliable, and cost\-effective data platforms that support FinOps, reporting, AI plans, and business decision\-making. The Senior Cloud Engineer partners with IT, Finance, architecture, and business teams to deliver and enhance enterprise data and automation solutions.


**Responsibilities**

* Lead the develop, and support of scalable cloud data solutions using Databricks, Azure, and AWS services.
* Architect and improve ETL/ELT pipelines, lakehouse patterns, and data transformation processes using Spark, PySpark, SQL, and Python.
* Develop and oversee secure API ingestion and integration patterns for internal, vendor, cloud, and enterprise data sources.
* Promote automation, monitoring, CI/CD, and Infrastructure as Code practices to improve platform reliability, repeatability, and operational efficiency.
* Partner with architecture, security, FinOps, analytics, and your team to ensure solutions are secure, governed, cost\-effective, and enterprise\-ready.
* Mentor engineers, establish reusable engineering standards, and provide technical leadership for cloud data platform delivery.

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 8\+ years of experience in cloud engineering, data engineering, systems integration, or related technical roles.
* Advanced hands\-on experience with Databricks, Spark, PySpark, SQL, and Python for enterprise\-scale data transformation and pipeline development.
* Experience designing API ingestion patterns and integrating enterprise, vendor, application, and cloud platform data sources.
* Experience optimising cloud\-native solutions within Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS).
* Experience with CI/CD, automation, monitoring, and Infrastructure as Code practices.
* English proficiency required, in written and spoken English with technical and your team.
* Technical work in a matrix environment.

**Must have skills :**

* Experience with Azure services such as Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Storage, Azure Functions, Azure Vault, Azure Monitor, or related services.
* Experience with AWS services such as S3, Lambda, Glue, Athena, RDS, CloudWatch, or related services.
* Experience with Delta Lake, lakehouse architecture, data modelling, and enterprise data governance concepts.
* Experience with Azure DevOps, GitHub, Git, Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates, or CloudFormation.
* Experience supporting analytics platforms such as Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, or similar reporting and data usage platforms.
* Understanding of cloud security practices, identity and access management, encryption, secrets management, and compliance requirements.
* Databricks, Microsoft Azure, AWS, or data engineering certifications required.
* Should resolve complex data, integration, or platform issues.

Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

16411e57.title: Principal Revenue & Finance System Architect
16411e57.description:
**Your work days are brighter here.**

We’re obsessed with making hard work pay off, for our people, our customers, and the world around us. As a Fortune 500 company and a leading AI platform for managing people, money, and agents, we’re shaping the future of work so teams can reach their potential and focus on what matters most. The minute you join, you’ll feel it. Not just in the products we build, but in how we show up for each other. Our culture is rooted in integrity, empathy, and shared enthusiasm. We’re in this together, tackling big challenges with bold ideas and genuine care. We look for curious minds and courageous collaborators who bring sun\-drenched optimism and drive. Whether you're building smarter solutions, supporting customers, or creating a space where everyone belongs, you’ll do meaningful work with Workmates who’ve got your back. In return, we’ll give you the trust to take risks, the tools to grow, the skills to develop and the support of a company invested in you for the long haul. So, if you want to inspire a brighter work day for everyone, including yourself, you’ve found a match in Workday, and we hope to be a match for you too.


**About the Team**

Join our team and experience Workday! It's fun to work in a company where people truly believe in what they're doing. At Workday, we're committed to bringing customer focus and continuous innovation to the business of enterprise applications. We are looking for a Revenue solutions and Workday Finance Principal Architect that is hardworking, innovative, and passionate about designing innovative programs that drive engagement and support business success. We invite you to join our Workday\-on\-Workday (WoW) team!
**About the Role**

Envision architecting a world\-class Revenue Management ecosystem utilizing Zuora at a global scale. You will be working on the cutting edge of Order\-to\-Cash and Revenue Recognition technology, influencing how our financial operations scale and thrive. If you are passionate about Zuora and Revenue Management, Workday Financials and want to drive impact on a global stage, this is your dream role.  

  



As the Principal Architect for Revenue Management and Workday Financials, you will work closely with product managers, finance stakeholders, and business analysts to design and optimize innovative solutions across our billing and revenue ecosystems, ensuring seamless integration with our Workday Finance core. Get ready to dive deep into complex challenges, collaborate with brilliant minds, and see your solutions directly impact global financial operations. You will analyze complex functional business problems and provide technical expertise in identifying, evaluating, and developing systems and procedures that best meet requirements.  

  



### **Key Responsibilities:**

* **Architect \& Design:** Design and architect scalable, efficient solutions within Zuora and automated Revenue Management platforms to support global billing operations and compliance.
* **Implementation \& Configuration:** Lead the configuration, optimization, and scaling of **Zuora modules** (e.g., Zuora Revenue) and oversee critical upstream/downstream integrations.
* **Product Expertise:** Stay up\-to\-date on Zuora product updates, features, and evolving revenue recognition standards (ASC 606 / IFRS 15\), proactively identifying opportunities to leverage them.
* **Business Collaboration:** Partner closely with Finance, Revenue Operations, and business teams to gather complex requirements, translating them into robust technical specifications.
* **Guidance \& Support:** Provide functional leadership, technical guidance, and mentorship to other team members, system analysts, and end\-users.
* **System Optimization:** Troubleshoot and resolve complex system, billing, or revenue data issues, ensuring the smooth, automated operation of the Order\-to\-Revenue pipeline.
* **Cross\-Functional Integration:** Partner with platform services and integration teams to ensure seamless data flow between CRM platforms, Zuora, and financial ERPs.
* **Process Improvement:** Continuous research and analysis of industry best practices in Order\-to\-Cash and Revenue Management to recommend strategic improvements to our processes.
* **Roadmap Strategy:** Help envision and execute the overall Zuora and Revenue Management technology roadmap.

**About You**

**About You**
-------------

### **Basic Qualifications:**

* **10\+ years** of experience delivering large\-scale enterprise engagements with a primary focus on **Zuora Revenue** and automated revenue management solutions for global customers.
* Strong subject matter expertise in **Revenue Recognition standards** (ASC 606 / IFRS 15\) and subscription\-based financial models.
* Proven experience working within an **Agile methodology** framework and utilizing project management tools like Jira and Confluence.

### **Preferred Qualifications (Nice\-to\-Have):**

* Validated domain experience with **Workday Finance** (specifically Contract to Cash, Professional Services, or Financial Management modules).
* Active certification in **Zuora** solutions or functional areas of **Workday Finance** is highly preferred.
* Experience managing or architecting the integration touchpoints between Zuora and Workday Finance ecosystems.

### **Other Qualifications:**

* Outstanding analytical reasoning and problem\-solving capabilities, with a confirmed ability to think strategically to tackle complex, global business questions.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to bridge the gap between technical architecture and finance stakeholders.

  

  

**Our Approach to Flexible Work**  



With Flex Work, we’re combining the best of both worlds: in\-person time and remote. Our approach enables our teams to deepen connections, maintain a strong community, and do their best work. We know that flexibility can take shape in many ways, so rather than a number of required days in\-office each week, we simply **spend at least half (50%) of our time each quarter in the office or in the field** with our customers, prospects, and partners (depending on role). This means you'll have the freedom to create a flexible schedule that caters to your business, team, and personal needs, while being intentional to make the most of time spent together. Those in our remote "home office" roles also have the opportunity to come together in our offices for important moments that matter.  



  

Workday is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals during our application process, in order to perform one or more essential functions of their job, as well as regarding the use of AI tools for employment decision\-making to any degree. Please see below for more details including how to request an accommodation as a qualified veteran, due to a disability or for religious reasons, or as otherwise provided under applicable law.  



  

Workday prohibits taking adverse action against any candidate or employee for reporting a possible violation of this policy, requesting one or more work accommodations, exercising a privacy right, or cooperating in an investigation in accordance with applicable law. Any employee who retaliates against a candidate or employee for doing so may be subject to disciplinary action, up to and including termination of employment, to the fullest extent allowable under applicable law.  



  

If you require a reasonable accommodation, you may email accommodations@workday.com , as far in advance as possible.  



  

**Are you being referred to one of our roles? If so, ask your connection at Workday about our Employee Referral process!**

At Workday, we value our candidates’ privacy and data security. Workday will never ask candidates to apply to jobs through websites that are not Workday Careers.  



Please be aware of sites that may ask for you to input your data in connection with a job posting that appears to be from Workday but is not.  



In addition, Workday will never ask candidates to pay a recruiting fee, or pay for consulting or coaching services, in order to apply for a job at Workday.

20f9f506.title: Senior Solution Consulting manager
20f9f506.description:
**About Impact Analytics**
 Impact Analytics is an agentic\-first AI software company transforming retail merchandising through cutting\-edge AI, LLMs, and Generative AI technologies. As a fast\-growing Series D company with deployments across five continents, it is building both industry\-leading merchandising solutions and foundational AI agents that are redefining how retail decisions are made.
   

  

 What makes Impact Analytics unique is its combination of deep retail domain expertise, strong innovation culture, and global presence. It is one of the few India\-born AI companies recognized globally by organizations like Fortune, Gartner, and the Inc. 5000\.
   

  

 For candidates looking to work on next\-generation AI products with global scale and real\-world impact, Impact Analytics is an exciting place to build your career. Here’s a link to our website: www.impactanalytics.co.
   

  

**The Impact That You Will Be Making**
 As a Senior Solutions Consulting Manager, you will serve as the primary customer\-facing expert leading solution design, process orchestration, and change management for Demand \& Replenishment Planning Solutions for Retail \& CPG clients. You are the functional powerhouse and architect for end\-to\-end, AI\-powered workflows. You will act as a critical liaison between project teams and key executive leadership, facilitating diagnostics and workshops to create robust solution design blueprints and ensuring seamless platform adoption.
   

  

**What This Role Entails**
**Solution Architecture \& Business Blueprinting**
* Lead Process Diagnostics: Facilitate and drive business diagnostics, process analysis, and design workshops to define as\-is/to\-be states for top\-tier retail and CPG clients.
* Author Functional Specifications: Draft comprehensive solution design documents, user stories, and technical requirements that align customer needs with IA's product capabilities with 100% traceability to financial outcomes.
* Design Multi\-Node Architectures: Architect scalable planning networks for complex retail scenarios like seasonal demand surges, multi\-tier distribution networks (DRP), vendor\-managed inventory (VMI), and supplier collaboration.


**Technical Governance \& AI/ML Forecasting Oversight**
* Advanced Engine Configuration: Configure and tune planning engines, overseeing logic for forecast disaggregation, outlier corrections, volume/value segmentation, and product phase\-in/phase\-out (NPI) workflows.
* Data Pipeline Validation: Model end\-to\-end supply chain integration layouts, ensuring robust data mapping, validation, and harmonization between legacy ERP/OMS systems and core predictive analytics layers.
* Agentic AI Orchestration: Leverage Agentic AI ecosystems to deploy autonomous agents for root\-cause analysis, scenario planning, automated workflow configuration, and demand\-supply exception management.


**Presales Execution \& Customer Success Delivery**
* Drive Proof\-of\-Value (PoV) Sessions: Lead solution demonstrations and tailored simulations, showcasing clear margin gains and dollar savings via live AI models to influence high\-stakes deals.
* Rigor in Testing \& Hypercare: Manage complex SIT/UAT testing loops, script validations, and defect triage cycles, taking full functional ownership of post\-go\-live hypercare stabilization phases.
* Change Management Evangelism: Coach enterprise customer planners and category heads through process re\-engineering, delivering customized user training bootcamps to maximize platform adoption.
* Team Mentorship: Lead, mentor, and build functional capability within junior consulting pods on product configuration best practices, AI/ML forecasting, and problem\-solving methodologies.


**What Lands You In This Role**
* Target Experience: 10–15 years of hands\-on solution design, configuration, or functional consulting experience implementing enterprise supply chain planning platforms.
* Elite Pedigree: Full\-time Master of Business Administration (MBA) from a Tier\-1 institution (e.g., IIMs, ISB, MDI, SIOM) strongly preferred, ideally paired with a technical or engineering undergraduate background (B.Tech/B.E.).
* Adjacent Platform Mastery: Deep functional familiarity with major target planning suites, including but not limited to Blue Yonder/JDA, o9 Solutions, Kinaxis RapidResponse, Anaplan, or E2open.
* Domain Domain Expertise: Proven technical mastery in Retail/CPG supply chains encompassing statistical baseline forecasting, causal modeling, multi\-echelon safety stock policies, ABC analysis, and network optimization.
* Technical \& Analytics Fluency: Comfort with relational databases and data modeling architectures, including hands\-on familiarity with SQL, advanced Excel, and visualization tools (Tableau/Power BI). Basic scripting knowledge in Python or R is highly valued.
* Certifications (Value\-Add): Professional credentials such as APICS CSCP/CPIM, PMP, CSPO, Lean Six Sigma Green Belt, or platform\-native implementation badges.


**What We Offer**
* Innovation at Speed: The opportunity to deploy bleeding\-edge Agentic AI solutions that outperform traditional, static planning systems.
* High\-Impact Ownership: A flat, collegial, and high\-growth startup environment where you define your own career path and chart your growth.
* Competitive Compensation: Best\-in\-class remuneration packages, including generous health benefits, performance incentives, and equity options.


**Some Of Our Accolades Include**
* Ranked as one of America's Fastest\-Growing Companies by Financial Times for five consecutive years: 2020\-2024\.
* Ranked as one of America's Fastest\-Growing Private Companies by Inc. 5000 for seven consecutive years: 2018\-2024\.
* Voted \#1 by more than 300 retailers worldwide in the RIS Software LeaderBoard 2024 report.
* Ranked \#72 in America’s Most Innovative Companies list in 2023—by Fortune—alongside companies like Microsoft, Tesla, Apple, IBM, etc.
* Forged a strategic partnership with Google to equip retailers with cutting\-edge generative AI tools.
* Recognized in multiple Gartner reports, including Market Guides and Hype Cycle, spanning assortments, merchandising, forecasting, algorithmic retailing, and Unified Price, Promotion, and Markdown Optimization Applications.

ccb12c08.title: Lead Managed Services Consultant
ccb12c08.description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI\-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
   

  

 By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer\-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real\-time insights.
   

  

 Today, 1,900\+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
 Lead managed services delivery for Sprinklr CCaaS customers, driving platform configuration, optimization, and adoption across digital and voice ecosystems. Act as a hands\-on solution lead ensuring scalable design, strong customer outcomes, and continuous value realization.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Translate customer business requirements into best\-practice CCaaS solutions aligned to Sprinklr capabilities and defined solution blueprints.
* Own and manage end\-to\-end configurations across omnichannel workflows, routing, IVR, case management, SLA frameworks, and automation.
* Manage and maintain core configuration architecture, ensuring alignment with customer blueprints, supportability, and scalability standards.
* Configure and optimize advanced routing models including skills\-based routing, priority logic, queue segmentation, and escalation workflows.
* Design and enhance IVR flows, voice queue logic, call routing paths, and contact center workflow automation.
* Build and optimize bot workflows, conversational AI journeys, and automation frameworks to improve containment, productivity, and customer experience.
* Drive platform adoption by aligning features to customer use cases, usage patterns, and operational objectives.
* Monitor and improve customer contact center operational metrics such as SLA adherence, AHT, queue performance, response times, productivity, and CSAT.
* Identify platform gaps and optimization opportunities and implement best practice solutioning to improve efficiency and service outcomes.
* Manage post go\-live changes, releases, configuration updates, and continuous platform improvements across the customer lifecycle.
* Support and guide API, CRM, telephony, and third\-party system integrations to enable connected workflows and unified service operations.
* Lead training and onboarding sessions for agents, admins, and customer teams to drive adoption of workflows, tools, and operating practices.
* Partner with Sales and Customer Success teams to identify new opportunities, drive platform consumption, and support upsell/cross\-sell discussions.
* Act as the primary technical and functional point of contact, advising stakeholders on solution design, adoption strategy, and operational improvements.
* Leverage AI and automation opportunities to improve ROI, efficiency, and service performance.


**What Makes You Qualified?**
**Must Have Qualifications**
* 5\+ years of experience in managed services, CCaaS, or technology consulting.
* Strong hands\-on experience with Sprinklr CCaaS or similar platforms such as Genesys, Cisco Webex Contact Center, Twilio Flex, or comparable solutions.
* Strong knowledge of IVR, routing strategies, queue management, chatbot workflows, case management, and SLA configurations.
* Experience designing and supporting omnichannel customer journeys across digital and voice channels.
* Understanding of telephony concepts such as VoIP, SIP, CTI, and ACD.
* Experience with API, CRM, and third\-party integrations.
* Hands\-on experience in system configuration, troubleshooting, and performance optimization.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate business needs into platform solutions.


**Good To Have Skills**
* Exposure to AI\-driven support models, automation use cases, and digital deflection strategies.
* Experience with social and digital engagement platforms.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving mindset with understanding of customer service KPIs.
* CCaaS certifications such as Genesys, Cisco, or Avaya preferred.


**Who You Are**
* A strong technical consultant with an ownership mindset.
* Able to independently manage customer outcomes and multiple engagements.
* Skilled at balancing hands\-on delivery with stakeholder engagement and solution guidance.
* Customer\-focused, solution\-oriented, and driven by continuous improvement.


**What Success Looks Like**
* High platform adoption and improved operational performance across customer accounts.
* Strong customer retention and measurable expansion opportunities.
* Successful delivery of scalable, optimized, and well\-governed CCaaS solutions.
* Recognition as a trusted advisor for day\-to\-day platform and service improvements.


**We focus on our mission** 
 : Sprinklr was founded in 2009 to solve a big problem: growing enterprise complexity that separated brands from their customers. Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI\-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
   

  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified\-CXM.
* Empower companies to deliver next generation, unified engagement journeys that reimagine the customer experience.
* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.


**We believe in our product** 
 : Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified\-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no\-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.
   

  

**We invest in our people** 
 : We offer a comprehensive suite of benefits designed to help each member of our team thrive. Sprinklr believes that you should be able to get the type of care you need for your personal well\-being when you need it. We offer you and your family voluntary healthcare coverage in countries where applicable. We believe it is important to take time off – it is essential for your mental and physical wellbeing. We provide Sprinklrites with paid time off to recharge and spend time with loved ones. We want to grow our talent with purpose. Our open Mentoring Program is designed to create meaningful connections that support growth and amplify our focus.
   

  

 To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
   

  

 To learn more about all\-things\-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
   

  

**EEO \- Our philosophy** 
 : Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
   

  

 Sprinklr is proud to be an equal\-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
   

  

 Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
   

  

**Warning about Recruiting Scams:** 
 Please be vigilant for recruiting scams impersonating Sprinklr. Sprinklr will never ask you for money, to pay for equipment, or for unnecessary personal information during the interview process. Sprinklr will also never pay in Bitcoin or send email communications from our executives. Please review the Federal Trade Commission's advice to avoid these types of scams.
   

  

 If you are contacted by someone whom you suspect may not be appropriately representing Sprinklr, please do not engage and block their email or phone number immediately.

We are the preferred choice of 1000\+ global enterprises to manage their 4 million\+ employees across 130\+ countries.
   

  

 Darwinbox's new\-age HCM suite competes with local as well as global players in the enterprise technology space (such as SAP, Oracle, and Workday). The firm has acquired notable customers ranging from large conglomerates to unicorn start\-ups: Nivea, Starbucks, DLF, JSW, Adani Group, Crisil, CRED, Vedanta, Mahindra, Glenmark, Gokongwei Group, Mitra Adiperkasa, EFS Facilities Management, VNG Corporation, and many more.
   

  

 Our vision of building a world\-class product company from Asia is backed by marquee global investors like Microsoft, Salesforce, Sequoia Capital, TCV, KKR, and Partners Group.
   

  

**Why Join Us?**
 The rate at which our product and market presence are growing is unprecedented. We’re a Rocketship. We’re not planning on slowing down anytime soon. And, that’s why we need you! You’ll experience a culture of:
   

  

* Disproportionate Rewards for top performance
* Accelerated Growth in a hyper\-growth environment
* Continuous Learning and Professional Development
* Meaningful Relationships and a Collaborative Environment


**What This Role Is**
 Darwinbox is transforming how enterprises manage people, workflows, and employee experiences at scale. As we evolve, implementation is no longer about configuration and delivery tracking. The real challenge is helping organizations rethink how HR should operate across systems, processes, adoption, and decision\-making.
   

  

**Candidates with exposure to North America implementations and an understanding of US statutory and compliance requirements will be preferred.**
 This role sits at the intersection of:
   

  

* Enterprise consulting
* Product thinking
* Customer transformation
* Large\-scale SaaS delivery
* You will act as:
* A trusted advisor to enterprise customers
* A strategic partner to CHROs and business leaders
* The “Voice of Customer” internally across Product and Engineering
* An owner responsible for customer outcomes — not just go\-live milestones


**What The Work Looks Like**
* You won’t just inherit a project plan. You’ll inherit ambiguity.
* A customer struggling to standardize processes globally.
* An implementation that technically works, but operationally doesn’t.
* A workflow designed for manual operations that now needs to scale intelligently.


 Your role is to understand the business problem behind the requirement and drive the transformation end\-to\-end.
   

  

 That means:
   

  

* Leading enterprise HCM transformation programs from discovery through adoption
* Challenging legacy processes and driving transformation conversations
* Influencing senior stakeholders with clarity and credibility
* Working closely with internal teams to shape customer outcomes
* Balancing customer expectations, scalability, product capabilities, and operational realities
* Because enterprise transformation breaks when those worlds operate separately.


**Who Thrives Here**
* People who think in systems.
* People who naturally ask: “Will this scale?” / “What breaks after go\-live?” / “Are we solving the actual customer problem?”
* People with consulting instincts, strong ownership mindset, and executive presence.
* People who care equally about customer outcomes, product experience, and operational excellence.


**What We Explicitly Don’t Optimize For**
* Coordination\-heavy implementation profiles
* Delivery managers who only track timelines
* Requirement takers who never challenge assumptions
* Governance without ownership
* Implementation thinking without business context


**What We’re Looking For**
* 6–12 years of experience in enterprise SaaS, HCM implementation, consulting, or transformation roles
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills
* Consulting mindset with ability to drive transformation conversations
* Strong customer advocacy and product\-oriented thinking
* Data\-driven and automation\-first approach to problem solving


**What We Offer:**
* A dynamic and collaborative work environment that fosters innovation.
* Opportunities for professional growth and career advancement.
* Competitive compensation and benefits package.
* The chance to work on products that make a meaningful impact on businesses and their employees.

b7066968.title: Technical Program Manager
b7066968.description:
**Program Manager (18–21 Years)** 




  





**Role Purpose** 




 The Program Manager is responsible for governing and coordinating multiple customer implementations and support engagements, ensuring successful delivery of IAN products and solutions across customers, teams, and delivery streams.
 



 The role provides portfolio\-level oversight across implementation, configuration, integration, quality assurance, data validation, cloud deployment, and support functions while driving delivery excellence, customer satisfaction, operational scalability, and successful business outcomes. The Program Manager works closely with Technical Project Managers, Implementation Architects, Delivery Leads, Product Teams, and Customer Stakeholders to ensure delivery commitments are met.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 



* Govern and oversee multiple customer implementations and support engagements.
* Manage program\-level planning, resource allocation, capacity management, and delivery forecasting.
* Ensure successful delivery of customer commitments, implementation milestones, support obligations, and business outcomes.
* Monitor overall program health, risks, dependencies, budgets, and delivery performance across customers.
* Partner with Technical Project Managers to ensure successful execution of customer implementation projects.
* Work closely with Implementation Architects, Lead Business Analysts, Lead Configurators, Lead Integration, Lead QA, AI \& Data Validation Specialists, and Support Delivery Leads to align delivery activities.
* Oversee implementation and adoption of workflow automation solutions leveraging technologies such as n8n, Camunda, Apache Camel, and related orchestration platforms.
* Coordinate environment readiness, deployment planning, release activities, production cutovers, and support transitions.
* Act as the primary escalation point for delivery, support, resource, and customer management issues.
* Drive customer governance meetings, steering committee reviews, executive reporting, and stakeholder communications.
* Track and report implementation progress, delivery performance, resource utilization, risks, and customer satisfaction metrics.
* Ensure smooth transition from implementation to production support and operational ownership.
* Support implementation planning, prioritization, staffing, and delivery optimization initiatives.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives across delivery, implementation, support, and operational processes.
* Collaborate with Product, Engineering, and Leadership teams to align customer needs with platform capabilities and product roadmap priorities.



**Required Skills \& Experience** 



* Bachelor's degree in computer science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or related field.
* 18–21 years of experience in technical program management, delivery management, implementation management, or professional services leadership.
* Strong experience in the Property \& Casualty (P\&C) Insurance domain; Knowledge of Commercial Lines and Specialty Insurance, considered an advantage.
* Experience managing multiple concurrent enterprise software implementations and customer engagements.
* Strong understanding of enterprise software implementation and delivery lifecycles.
* Good understanding of workflow automation platforms, configurable enterprise applications, and implementation\-driven delivery models.
* Good understanding of BPMN\-based workflow automation, business process orchestration platforms such as Camunda, Flowable, Appian or similar technologies.
* Understanding enterprise integrations, APIs, data migration, and cloud\-based solution deployments.
* Understanding of cloud hosting models, environment management, deployment planning, and release coordination across Azure environments.
* Ability to manage delivery dependencies across workflows, integrations, business rules, forms, cloud environments, data validation, and customer onboarding activities.
* Experience managing cross\-functional delivery teams comprising Architects, Business Analysts, Configurators, Developers, QA, Data Validation, and Support teams.
* Strong understanding of Agile delivery, release management, customer onboarding, and support transition processes.
* Experience managing customer escalations, delivery risks, budgets, and program dependencies.
* Strong understanding of resource planning, capacity management, utilization tracking, and delivery forecasting.
* Excellent stakeholder management, executive communication, leadership, and decision\-making skills.
* Proven experience working with insurance carriers and clients across North America or Europe.



**Desired Skills** 



* Experience with intelligent automation, document processing, AI\-enabled solutions, or workflow\-driven platforms.
* Experience working with SaaS platforms, InsurTech solutions, or enterprise workflow automation products.
* PMP, PgMP, SAFe, PRINCE2, or equivalent program management certification.

969883ce.title: Presales Solutions Architect
969883ce.description:
**Data \& AI Presales Solution Architect** 




**Location:** 




 Bengaluru / Noida / Chennai
 



  





**Position Overview** 




 We are looking for a dynamic and client\-focused Data \& AI Presales Solution Architect who brings deep presales expertise combined with strong solution design and delivery capability. This is a high\-impact, customer\-facing role responsible for driving revenue growth by crafting winning proposals, leading solution discussions, and architecting compelling Data \& AI solutions for enterprise clients.
 



  





 This role covers the full Data Management landscape including Data Governance, Master Data Management, Metadata Management, Data Cataloging, Data Quality, Data Privacy, and cloud\-native Data \& AI platforms on AWS, Microsoft Azure, and Google Cloud Platform.
 



  





**Role Purpose** 




 The Presales Solution Architect will be the primary technical and solution owner during the presales phase — partnering closely with sales, practice, delivery, and technology alliances to win strategic Data \& AI deals. Beyond presales, the role will also lead solution workshops, architecture engagements, and client advisory sessions to ensure successful deal shaping and delivery transition.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




**Presales Ownership \& Deal Pursuit** 



* Own and drive end\-to\-end presales solutioning for Data Management, Data Governance, MDM, Data Quality, Metadata, Data Privacy, and Data \& AI opportunities.
* Engage proactively with clients from initial discovery through RFP response, solution presentation, orals defense, and deal closure.
* Analyze RFPs, RFIs, RFQs, and client briefs to develop fit\-for\-purpose, differentiated, and commercially compelling solution responses.
* Lead client discovery workshops, requirements sessions, maturity assessments, and solution walkthroughs to deeply understand client pain points and buying criteria.
* Build trusted relationships with client CDOs, data governance councils, technology leaders, and business stakeholders during the presales process.
* Drive pursuit strategy, win themes, and solution differentiation in collaboration with sales and practice leadership.



  





**Solution Architecture \& Design** 



* Design target\-state architectures, governance operating models, stewardship workflows, platform blueprints, and implementation roadmaps aligned to client objectives.
* Create proposal\-ready architecture narratives, logical architecture diagrams, capability maps, technology stack recommendations, and data management maturity assessments.
* Develop solution estimation inputs including work breakdown structures, delivery phasing, team composition, assumptions, risks, and accelerator leverage.
* Design cloud\-native data management architectures on Azure, AWS, and GCP using platform\-native and third\-party data management tools.



  





**Client Solution \& Advisory Engagements** 



* Lead solution architecture workshops, advisory engagements, proof\-of\-concept designs, and transformation roadmap sessions for strategic clients.
* Present solution architectures, operating models, and business cases to CxO and senior stakeholder audiences with confidence and clarity.



  





**Reusable Assets \& Practice Development** 



* Build and maintain a library of reusable proposal assets, solution frameworks, architecture patterns, and accelerators to improve presales efficiency.
* Contribute to practice\-building initiatives including solution playbooks, capability offerings, case studies, and point of view documents.



  





**Core Competencies \& Technical Expertise** 




**Presales \& Client Engagement** 



* Proven track record of owning end\-to\-end presales cycles for Data \& AI, Data Management, or Analytics deals in a consulting or technology services environment.
* Experience responding to complex RFPs/RFIs/RFQs and leading proposal responses, solution presentations, and orals defense sessions.



  





**Cloud \& Platform Expertise** 



* Strong understanding of cloud\-native data management services across:
* Azure: Microsoft Purview, Azure Data Lake, Azure Synapse, Azure Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Azure Data Factory
* AWS: AWS Glue Data Catalog, AWS Lake Formation, Amazon S3, Amazon Redshift, AWS DMS, AWS governance and security services
* GCP: Dataplex, Data Catalog, BigQuery, Cloud Storage, Dataflow, Dataproc, GCP data governance patterns
* Experience with leading Data Governance, Catalog, Metadata, Quality, MDM, and Privacy platforms: Collibra, Alation, Microsoft Purview, Informatica EDC / Axon / IDQ / MDM, IBM InfoSphere / IBM IGC / IBM Guardium, Stibo Systems, Reltio, TIBCO



  





**Required Qualifications** 



* MBA (Master of Business Administration) is mandatory — candidates without an MBA will not be considered for this role.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, or a related technical field is required as the undergraduate foundation.
* Minimum 10 years of experience in Data Management, Data Governance, MDM, Data Quality, Metadata Management, or Data \& AI technologies.
* At least 4–5 years in a dedicated presales, solution architecture, or consulting role with direct client\-facing presales accountability.
* Demonstrated experience owning deal pursuits, driving RFP responses, and presenting solutions to senior client stakeholders.

da2e8ec1.description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Unified Support Services (USS) Solution Architect \& Product Owner, Support Experience Platforms (U642\)**
 At EY, you'll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we're counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

 EY is a global leader in assurance, tax, transaction and advisory services. Technology is at the heart of what we do and deliver at EY. Technology solutions are integrated in the client services we deliver and are key to our innovation as an organization. As part of Enterprise Technology, you'll be at the forefront of integrating technology into what we do at EY. That means more growth for you, exciting learning opportunities, career choices and the chance to make a real impact.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 EY's global Enterprise Technology group provides enabling services across enterprise platforms, infrastructure, digital workplace and service operations. The Solution Architect \& Product Owner is a pivotal role within Unified Support Services, accountable for the end\-to\-end solution architecture, integration strategy, product roadmap and delivery of Support Experience platforms.
   

  

 The role serves as the architectural authority for the Support Experience technology ecosystem. The individual will design, govern and enable integrated solutions across ServiceNow, Genesys Cloud, LogMeIn Rescue, Qualtrics, Nexthink, Microsoft Copilot, knowledge platforms, automation solutions and other Service Desk technologies. The role requires deep ServiceNow architecture expertise, strong systems integration capability and sufficient product ownership experience to translate business priorities into a coherent architecture and executable roadmap.
   

  

 The successful candidate will bring together business, product, architecture, engineering, security, operations and vendor teams to deliver scalable, secure, resilient and user\-centered support solutions from concept through implementation and operational adoption.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Act as the lead Solution Architect and design authority for the Unified Support Services Support Experience ecosystem.
* Define current\-state, target\-state and transition architectures for Support Experience platforms, including the supporting technology roadmap.
* Own end\-to\-end solution design across user channels, workflows, integrations, data, knowledge, automation, AI capabilities and operational processes.
* Provide architectural leadership across ServiceNow ITSM, r, Virtual Agent, Service Catalog, Knowledge Management, CMDB, IntegrationHub and Flow Designer.
* Design scalable ServiceNow solutions, data models, workflows and platform extensions while protecting platform integrity, maintainability and upgradeability.
* Own the end\-to\-end integration strategy across ServiceNow, Genesys Cloud, LogMeIn Rescue, Qualtrics, Nexthink, Microsoft Copilot, Microsoft Teams, identity services, enterprise knowledge and automation platforms.
* Define API\-led, event\-driven, workflow\-based and middleware integration patterns, including authentication, authorization, error handling, monitoring, data synchronization and recovery.
* Enable continuity of identity, conversation, intent, device context, case context and interaction history across chatbot, live chat, voice, portal, remote support and assisted\-service channels.
* Lead the Genesys integration roadmap with ITSM and digital channels to support intelligent routing and escalation between virtual, digital and voice channels without avoidable loss of context.
* Architect secure integration with LogMeIn Rescue, including remote\-session launch, user and case context, technician workflow, audit information and case updates.
* Architect the use of Nexthink telemetry and automation capabilities to support proactive issue identification, contextual diagnostics and remediation workflows.

8376fc99.description:
Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers \- amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life\-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility \- our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better.
   

  

 We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us!
   

  

**Job Description**
**Position Summary**
 The Cloud Engineer, focused on cloud data platforms and integration, is responsible for building, supporting, and maintaining scalable cloud\-based data solutions across Azure and AWS. This role provides hands\-on engineering support for Databricks, data transformation, API ingestion, and cloud\-native services while following enterprise standards for security, reliability, governance, and cost efficiency. The Cloud Engineer partners with technical teams and business stakeholders to enable trusted data delivery for reporting, analytics, AI, and operational decision\-making. This position reports directly to the FinOps Technical Leader and works closely with the FinOps team to support cloud and AI financial management, data engineering, automation, and reporting initiatives.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
* Build, support, and maintain cloud\-based data solutions using Databricks, Azure, and AWS services.
* Develop data ingestion and transformation pipelines using Spark, PySpark, SQL, Python, and ETL/ELT patterns.
* Support API\-based data ingestion from internal, vendor, cloud, and enterprise platforms.
* Assist with monitoring, troubleshooting, documentation, and operational support for cloud data pipelines and integrations.
* Collaborate with architecture, security, FinOps, analytics, and business teams to deliver reliable and cost\-effective data solutions.
* Follow engineering standards, governance practices, and deployment processes for secure and scalable delivery.


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field (or equivalent experience).
* 5\+ years of experience in cloud engineering, data engineering, systems integration, or related technical roles.
* Hands\-on experience with Databricks, Spark, SQL, Python, and data transformation or pipeline development.
* Experience developing or consuming REST APIs for data ingestion and enterprise system integration.
* Experience building or supporting cloud\-native solutions within Microsoft Azure and Amazon Web Services (AWS).
* English proficiency required, with the ability to communicate clearly in written and spoken English with technical and business stakeholders.
* Proven ability to work effectively in a matrixed, cross\-functional environment.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience with Azure services such as Azure Databricks, Azure Data Factory, Azure Storage, Azure Functions, Azure Key Vault, Azure Monitor, or related services.
* Experience with AWS services such as S3, Lambda, Glue, Athena, RDS, CloudWatch, or related services.
* Experience with Delta Lake, lakehouse architecture, data modeling, or data governance concepts.
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps, GitHub, Git, Terraform, Bicep, ARM templates, or CloudFormation.
* Experience supporting analytics platforms such as Power BI, Microsoft Fabric, Synapse, or similar reporting and data consumption platforms.
* Understanding of cloud security practices, identity and access management, encryption, secrets management, and compliance requirements.
* Databricks, Microsoft Azure, AWS, or data engineering certifications preferred.
* Strong critical thinking and problem\-solving skills, with experience resolving data, integration, or platform issues.
* Self\-directed and proactive, with strong ownership, accountability, communication, and documentation skills.


 Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

We are looking for a Finance Automation Specialist to join the ERP \& Automation team. In this role you will own the design, build and run of automation across our finance landscape — from Dynamics 365 F\&O workflow configuration and Power Platform apps, to custom integrations and AI\-assisted document processing.
  
  

This is a hands\-on, delivery\-focused role. You will sit at the intersection of Finance and Technology: talking to controllers and AP/AR leads to understand where the manual effort actually is, then building and shipping the automation that removes it. Success is measured in hours saved, errors eliminated and close cycles shortened — not in tickets closed.
  
  

Process Discovery \& Solution Design
  
  

* Partner with Finance stakeholders across Record\-to\-Report, Procure\-to\-Pay, Order\-to\-Cash, Treasury and Tax to map current\-state processes and identify automation candidates.
* Build the business case for each initiative — effort baseline, expected savings, risk reduction — and prioritise the automation backlog with the ERP \& Automation lead.
* Choose the right tool for each problem: native D365 configuration first, then low\-code, then custom code. Avoid over\-engineering.
* Document as\-is and to\-be process flows, functional specifications, and solution design documents.


Dynamics 365 Finance \& Operations
  
  

* Configure and extend D365 F\&O finance modules — General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Cash \& Bank Management, Budgeting, Expense Management.
* Build and maintain workflows, approval hierarchies, posting profiles, financial dimensions and number sequences.
* Develop and maintain Electronic Reporting (ER) configurations, Financial Reporter statements, and Data Entities for import/export.
* Support month\-end and year\-end close from a systems standpoint; identify and remove recurring close bottlenecks.
* Work with X\+\+ / D365 extensions where configuration cannot meet the requirement, in coordination with technical developers.


RPA \& Low\-Code Workflow Automation
  
  

* Design, build, test and deploy automations using Power Automate (cloud and desktop flows), and RPA platforms such as UiPath or Automation Anywhere.
* Build Power Apps front\-ends for finance processes that live outside the ERP — approvals, exception handling, data collection, reconciliations.
* Automate high\-volume, rules\-based finance work: invoice processing, three\-way match exceptions, payment run preparation, bank and intercompany reconciliations, journal uploads, dunning and collections follow\-ups, vendor and customer master data maintenance.
* Own the bot estate in production — monitoring, exception handling, error alerting, scheduling and version control.


Integrations, Data \& Custom Development
  
  

* Build and support integrations between D365 F\&O and surrounding systems — banking portals, tax and e\-invoicing platforms, expense tools, procurement systems, CRM and data warehouse.
* Write Python and SQL to build data pipelines, transformation logic, validation routines and reconciliation scripts.
* Work with REST/OData APIs, Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions, Data Factory and Dataverse to move and reconcile data reliably.
* Build finance reporting and dashboards in Power BI on top of automated data flows.


AI \& Intelligent Automation
  
  

* Apply AI Builder, Azure Document Intelligence and LLM\-based tooling to unstructured finance inputs — vendor invoices, remittance advices, bank statements, contracts, GRNs.
* Prototype and deploy AI\-assisted use cases such as intelligent invoice coding, anomaly detection on journals and expenses, automated variance commentary, and agentic workflows for exception resolution.
* Establish human\-in\-the\-loop review, confidence thresholds and audit trails so AI\-assisted output remains controlled and auditable.


Controls, Governance \& Support
  
  

* Ensure every automation respects segregation of duties, approval limits, and SOX / internal control requirements; maintain documentation for internal and statutory audit.
* Manage change through proper SIT/UAT cycles, sign\-offs and release governance; maintain test scripts and regression packs.
* Provide L2/L3 support for finance automation in production, conduct root cause analysis, and track incidents to closure.
* Train finance users, publish SOPs and job aids, and drive adoption of what you build.
* Track and report automation benefits — FTE hours released, error rates, cycle time, straight\-through processing rate.


**.css\-108vfo6{padding\-top:** 24px;padding\-bottom: 12px;font\-size: 20px;font\-weight: 700;}
  
Job Requirement
  
Experience
  
  

* 3–6 years of experience in ERP\-based finance systems, finance transformation, or business process automation.
* Hands\-on delivery experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance \& Operations (or D365 Finance / AX 2012 with migration exposure), specifically in finance modules.
* Demonstrated track record of shipping automations into production — please be ready to walk through 2–3 examples end to end.


Technical Skills
  
  

* D365 F\&O: finance module configuration, workflows, financial dimensions, Data Entities, Electronic Reporting, Financial Reporter.
* Power Platform: Power Automate (cloud \+ desktop flows), Power Apps, Dataverse, Power BI.
* RPA: UiPath, Automation Anywhere or Power Automate Desktop — design, exception handling, orchestration.

**JOB DESCRIPTION**  

**GENERAL SUMMARY**  

Drive the architecture, design, and implementation of enterprise\-scale AI, machine learning, and data science solutions leveraging the organization's ModelOps platforms, including Databricks and Posit. Ensure solutions are designed, developed, and deployed in alignment with enterprise architecture standards, platform best practices, security requirements, and operational objectives. Serve as a trusted technical advisor, bridging business requirements and technical implementation by developing scalable architectural patterns, solution blueprints, and deployment strategies that enable reliable, secure, and efficient model delivery. Partner closely with data scientists, data engineers, actuarial teams, business stakeholders, platform engineering, and AI enablement teams to guide solution design decisions and promote best practices across the entire ML lifecycle, including development, testing, deployment, monitoring, and governance. Provide architectural oversight and technical leadership to ensure AI/ML solutions are scalable, maintainable, cost\-effective, and aligned with organizational goals.  

**PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES\-ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS*** **Solution Architecture and Design:** Provide architectural leadership and consultation for AI/ML, advanced analytics, and data science solutions leveraging the enterprise ModelOps platforms, including Databricks and Posit. Define and promote architecture standards, reference patterns, and best practices for model development, deployment, monitoring, governance, and lifecycle management. Translate business and technical requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable solution architectures that align with enterprise architecture standards and cloud\-native principles. Establish integration patterns across data, application, and governance ecosystems while ensuring solutions are designed for performance, reliability, and operational supportability. Conduct architecture reviews and provide technical guidance to enable consistent, reusable, and sustainable solution delivery across development teams.
* **Technical Leadership and Strategy:** Provide technical leadership and strategic direction for the adoption and implementation of ModelOps solutions across the organization. Translate complex business, analytical, and operational requirements into scalable, secure, and maintainable architecture strategies and roadmaps. Lead architectural decision\-making for data pipelines, machine learning models, applications, APIs, and end\-to\-end ML workflows while ensuring alignment with enterprise architecture standards and organizational objectives. Define and promote best practices, design patterns, and governance standards for Databricks (including Unity Catalog, Workflows, Delta Live Tables, and SQL Warehouses) and Posit (including Workbench, and Connect). Partner closely with platform engineering and enablement teams to drive platform adoption, influence future platform capabilities, and ensure consistent implementation of enterprise standards across solution development teams.
* **Stakeholder Collaboration and Communication:** Serve as the primary technical liaison between business stakeholders, regional data science teams, platform engineering, IT operations, and executive leadership to ensure alignment between business objectives and technology solutions. Translate business, analytical, and operational requirements into clear technical specifications, architectural designs, and implementation recommendations. Communicate architectural strategies, solution options, and technical tradeoffs to both technical and non\-technical audiences, facilitating informed decision\-making and stakeholder buy\-in. Build and maintain strong relationships with technical champions and key stakeholders across the organization to promote adoption of enterprise platforms, standards, and best practices. Foster collaboration across cross\-functional teams to drive successful delivery of scalable, secure, and business\-aligned AI/ML solutions.
* **Model Lifecycle Management:** Establish and guide the adoption of enterprise ModelOps frameworks that support the full model lifecycle, from development and validation through production deployment, monitoring, and retirement. Define architectural patterns and best practices for model versioning, reproducibility, model registries, automated testing, deployment pipelines, A/B testing, and model retraining workflows. Ensure solutions align with enterprise model governance standards, validation processes, monitoring requirements, and operational support frameworks. Collaborate with data science, engineering, and risk management teams to promote reliable, transparent, and auditable model operations. Ensure compliance with regulatory requirements, internal policies, and risk management standards while supporting the delivery of scalable and sustainable AI/ML solutions.
* **Performance Optimization and Scalability:** Design and promote architecture patterns that optimize the performance, scalability, reliability, security, and cost efficiency of AI/ML and data science solutions across enterprise ModelOps platforms. Lead the development of distributed computing strategies leveraging Databricks capabilities, including cluster management, workload orchestration, and compute optimization. Define resource allocation, capacity planning, and scaling frameworks to support current and future business demands across Databricks and Posit environments. Establish architectural standards for observability, monitoring, alerting, and performance measurement to ensure platform health, operational resilience, and proactive issue identification. Collaborate with platform engineering teams to continuously evaluate and enhance platform utilization, throughput, and operational efficiency while maintaining alignment with enterprise standards and service\-level objectives.
* **Technical Mentorship and Documentation:** Provide technical leadership, guidance, and mentorship to data scientists, data engineers, and development teams to promote adoption of enterprise architecture standards, platform capabilities, and ModelOps best practices. Conduct architecture reviews, design assessments, and technical consultations to ensure solutions align with established patterns, governance requirements, and operational objectives. Develop and maintain comprehensive technical documentation, including reference architectures, solution designs, integration patterns, deployment standards, and operational runbooks. Lead training sessions, workshops, and knowledge\-sharing initiatives to build organizational capabilities and drive consistent implementation of AI/ML solutions across teams. Foster a culture of continuous learning, technical excellence, and collaboration while enabling teams to effectively leverage Databricks, Posit, and related platform services.
* **Risk Management and Compliance:** Establish architectural controls, governance frameworks, and risk mitigation strategies to ensure secure, reliable, and compliant AI/ML solutions throughout the model lifecycle. Partner with data governance, information security, model risk management, and compliance teams to ensure adherence to data privacy, security, regulatory, and enterprise policy requirements. Design solutions that support auditability, data lineage, model traceability, and operational transparency through comprehensive monitoring, logging, and reporting capabilities. Define and promote architecture patterns for business continuity, backup, disaster recovery, and operational resilience across ModelOps platforms and supporting technologies. Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate technical and operational risks while ensuring alignment with governance requirements within highly regulated insurance and financial services environments.
* Maintain regular and predictable attendance.
* Perform other duties as required.

**JOB SPECIFICATIONS**  

**Education and Experience**  

**Required:*** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Data Science, or related technical field
* 8\+ years of experience in solution architecture, data engineering, data science, or related technical roles
* 3\+ years of hands\-on experience designing and implementing enterprise\-grade data science and analytics solutions
* Proven experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and cloud\-native architecture principles

**Preferred:*** Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Software Engineering, Data Science, or related field

* Cloud architecture certifications (AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Solutions Architect, or GCP Professional Architect)

* Understanding of data security principles including authentication, authorization, encryption, RBAC, and compliance frameworks

* Excellent communication skills with ability to present complex technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders
* Proven ability to translate business requirements into technical architecture and design specifications
* Ability to quickly adapt to new technologies, work under tight deadlines, and manage multiple priorities
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities with investigative mindset

* Experience with additional ML platforms and frameworks (SageMaker, MLFlow, AzureML, Kubeflow)
