98405c77.description:
Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world.


**Your Role**
-------------


As a Cloud Security Consultant / Lead / Architect at Capgemini, you will be responsible for strengthening cloud security posture across Azure and AWS environments by leveraging CNAPP technologies and cloud security best practices. You will work closely with SOC teams, cloud analysts, and customer stakeholders to ensure secure, compliant, and resilient cloud operations.


* Manage, configure, and continuously enhance security policies and controls across Azure and AWS cloud assets.
* Optimize and maintain Microsoft CNAPP, CSPM, CWPP, and CASB solutions in alignment with customer ISMS and compliance requirements.
* Provide technical leadership for cloud security monitoring, threat detection, alert analysis, remediation planning, and incident response activities.
* Integrate cloud security platforms with SOC tools and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to improve visibility, governance, and response capabilities.
* Prepare security dashboards, audit documentation, weekly/monthly reports, and recommend best practices for securing cloud\-native applications and workloads.
**Your Profile**
----------------


* Hands\-on experience in Azure and/or AWS Cloud Security with a strong understanding of cloud\-native security controls and architectures.
* Expertise in Microsoft CNAPP, CSPM (Cloud Security Posture Management), CWPP (Cloud Workload Protection Platform), and CASB (Cloud Access Security Broker) technologies.
* Strong knowledge of cloud security frameworks, compliance standards, risk management, and Information Security Management Systems (ISMS).
* Experience integrating cloud security solutions with SOC tools, SIEM platforms, and security operations processes.
* Strong analytical, reporting, documentation, and stakeholder management skills, with proficiency in Microsoft Office 365 tools (Excel, Word, PowerPoint).
Capgemini is an AI\-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end\-to\-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2024 global revenues of €22\.1 billion.

e90825c8.title: Product Delivery Manager
e90825c8.description:
**About the Role** 




  





 We are looking for a highly driven
 **Project Manager to lead the end\-to\-end delivery of Turium AI products and platforms** 
 , working closely with our engineering, AI, product and leadership teams.
 



 This is not a traditional coordination\-only project management role. We need someone who can
 **own delivery, drive developers, remove blockers, challenge timelines and ensure high\-quality product releases reach users on schedule** 
 .
 



 You will be responsible for turning product vision and requirements into clear execution plans and ensuring the engineering team remains aligned, accountable and focused on shipping.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Product Delivery** 




  




* Own end\-to\-end delivery across Turium AI products and technology initiatives.
* Convert product requirements and leadership direction into clearly defined epics, user stories, tasks and milestones.
* Build and maintain sprint plans, release plans and product delivery roadmaps.
* Ensure features move efficiently from
 **requirements → development → testing → release** 
 .
* Track dependencies between frontend, backend, mobile, AI and infrastructure teams.
* Drive releases against ambitious timelines without compromising quality.
* Identify delivery risks early and establish mitigation plans.
* Maintain clear visibility of overall product readiness and release status.



  





**Developer Management** 




  




* Manage day\-to\-day execution across frontend, backend, mobile, AI and infrastructure development teams.
* Run daily stand\-ups and maintain clear ownership of every development activity.
* Ensure developers understand requirements, acceptance criteria and priorities before development begins.
* Track individual and team commitments against sprint objectives.
* Challenge unrealistic estimates and identify delays before they impact releases.
* Remove blockers quickly by coordinating across technical and business teams.
* Ensure engineering teams maintain appropriate documentation, testing and code review practices.
* Work closely with technical leads to balance speed, architecture, scalability and technical debt.
* Hold developers accountable for agreed timelines, quality and delivery commitments.



  





**Sprint \& Agile Management** 




  




* Own sprint planning, backlog grooming, retrospectives and delivery reviews.
* Maintain a prioritised and healthy product backlog.
* Define clear sprint objectives and measurable deliverables.
* Ensure every task has an owner, deadline and acceptance criteria.
* Track sprint velocity, completion rates and delivery predictability.
* Prevent tasks from remaining indefinitely "in progress."
* Escalate missed commitments and recurring delivery issues quickly.
* Continuously improve development processes and team productivity.



  





**Quality \& Release Management** 




  




* Coordinate development, QA, UAT and production releases.
* Ensure every major feature has appropriate test scenarios and acceptance criteria.
* Maintain release checklists and go/no\-go criteria.
* Track bugs based on severity and customer impact.
* Ensure critical defects are resolved before production release.
* Coordinate post\-release monitoring and issue resolution.
* Maintain clear release notes and deployment status.
* Drive continuous improvement based on user feedback and product performance.



  





**Communication \& Reporting** 




 Provide leadership with concise daily and weekly updates covering:
 



  




* Completed work
* Current priorities
* Upcoming releases
* Risks and blockers
* Delayed deliverables
* Team capacity
* Decisions required



  





 Maintain a
 **single source of truth for Turium product delivery** 
 , ensuring complete visibility around who owns each activity, its current status and when it will be delivered.
 



 Escalate issues early rather than allowing deadlines to slip silently.
 



  





**What We Are Looking For** 




  




* 5\+ years of experience in
 **technology project management, product delivery or software engineering delivery** 
 .
* Proven experience managing software developers and engineering teams.
* Experience delivering modern SaaS, consumer applications or AI\-powered products.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle.
* Strong understanding of frontend, backend, APIs, cloud infrastructure and mobile application development.
* Experience managing Agile/Scrum development teams.
* Strong experience with Jira, Linear or similar project management platforms.
* Ability to understand technical discussions without necessarily being a hands\-on developer.
* Exceptional organisation and attention to detail.
* Strong ability to hold teams accountable while maintaining a productive working environment.
* Comfortable operating in a fast\-moving technology environment with ambitious delivery targets.



  





**Highly Desirable** 




  





 Experience working with one or more of the following would be highly regarded:
 


* AI / LLM\-powered products
* Real\-time communication platforms
* Voice and video applications
* Consumer or enterprise mobile applications
* React / Next.js
* Go
* Microservices
* WebRTC
* Authentication and identity platforms
* Cloud\-native environments
* High\-scale technology platforms



  





**Success in This Role** 




 Within the first few months, we expect the Project Manager to establish:
 



  




* A clear Turium product roadmap and release calendar.
* Predictable development sprints.
* Clear ownership across every engineering activity.
* Strong accountability across developers.
* Early identification of risks and blockers.
* Significantly improved delivery visibility.
* Faster movement from requirement to production.
* A disciplined release process.
* Higher developer productivity and delivery predictability.
* A culture where commitments, timelines and quality matter.



  





**The Person We Want** 




  





 We are looking for someone who is
 **high\-energy, organised, technically strong and obsessed with execution** 
 .
 



  





 You should naturally ask:
 



  





**What are we shipping?** 




**Who owns it?** 




**When will it be finished?** 




**What is blocking it?** 




**What needs to happen next?** 




**You must be comfortable working directly with founders and senior leadership, managing multiple engineering streams simultaneously and taking personal ownership for getting Turium products shipped** 
 .
 



  





 This role is ideal for someone who wants to help build and launch ambitious global AI products rather than simply manage a project plan.

 If you’re looking for meaningful work, smart teammates and the chance to make a real impact in a high\-growth company that’s redefining security operations, Arctic Wolf is the right place for you!
   

  

 We’re looking for a
 **Senior Program Manager** 
 to be part of making this happen.
   

  

**Position Overview And Objective**
 The Senior Program Manager will manage and lead programs to drive the engineering development and implementation process for a subsystem and component of a product or service offering. Involvement lasts throughout all stages of a product’s lifecycle including ideation/concept, modifications, upgrades and maintenance of the product or product line.
   

  

 The Senior Program Manager will manage and lead strategic programs and initiatives within our cybersecurity software and services organization. This role is responsible for planning, executing, and delivering complex programs that align with business objectives, customer needs, and regulatory requirements. The ideal candidate will drive cross\-functional collaboration, ensure program alignment with company strategy, and manage risks and dependencies to deliver high\-quality security solutions on time and within budget.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Strategic Influence \& Thought Leadership – Guides executive decision\-making on product strategy, technology investments, and long\-term roadmap planning.
* Enterprise\-Wide Program Management – Oversees multiple complex initiatives spanning business units, ensuring strategic objectives are met across products and teams.
* Technical Due Diligence – Leads deep dives into system architecture, performance, and scalability to assess risk and feasibility for high\-impact initiatives.
* Executive \& Stakeholder Alignment – Communicates trade\-offs, investment rationales, and progress updates to C\-suite and board\-level stakeholders.
* Mentorship \& Organization Impact – Develops best practices, frameworks, and coaching initiatives to elevate program management capabilities across the company.
* Lead and manage large\-scale cybersecurity programs from initiation through completion, ensuring alignment with company objectives.
* Develop and maintain program roadmaps, timelines, and deliverables, ensuring effective coordination across engineering, product management, marketing, legal, sales and customer success teams.
* Oversee program governance, risk management, and compliance with industry security standards and regulations.
* Define and implement best practices for program execution, tracking, and reporting, ensuring visibility and accountability.
* Serves as the primary point of contact for program stakeholders, facilitating communication and alignment across business units.
* Manage budgets, resource allocation, and vendor relationships to optimize program efficiency.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance program execution, team collaboration, and customer satisfaction.
* Serves as the central resource with design, process, manufacturing, test, quality, and marketing as the product(s) move to production and distribution.
* Designs, develops, and manages activities for a specific product or group of products from product definition and planning through production, release, and end of life.
* Coordinate activities of supporting project teams and internal and external development partners.
* Track progress against established plan and makes decisions to alter or update schedule and resource allocation to meet product requirements and development schedule.
* Mentor direct and interdisciplinary team members.
* Champion AI \& Automation in Program Management – Identify and implement AI\-driven tools and automation workflows to streamline program planning, status reporting, risk tracking, and cross\-functional coordination, reducing manual overhead and improving program execution speed.
* Drive data\-driven insights by leveraging AI\-powered analytics and dashboards to proactively surface program health metrics, predict delivery risks, and support executive\-level decision\-making with real\-time program intelligence.


**Experience \& Requirements**
* 12\+ years’ experience in a technical or product role managing large\-scale software deployments
* 12\+ years of experience in program / project/ product management, with at least 8 years in software development
* Bachelor’s degree required in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Business, or related field
* Understanding of project and program management skills and methodologies
* Expertise in program management methodologies (Agile, SAFe, etc.) and tools (JIRA, Confluence, Aha!, etc.).
* Ability to navigate complex stakeholder environments, ensuring effective communication between technical and non\-technical teams.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills to identify risks, dependencies, and optimization opportunities.
* Excellent leadership, negotiation, and change management skills to drive execution and adoption of cybersecurity initiatives.
* Experience communicating and representing work to leadership, framing discussions to gain valuable feedback, and experience working with technical management teams to develop systems, solutions, and products.
* Analytical and problem\-solving experience with large\-scale systems
* Proficient in building trust and establishing relationships across multi\-disciplinary teams.
* Aptitude towards establishing and leading teams through multi\-disciplinary relationships including product management and engineering to drive product programs.


**Nice to Have**
* PMP, PgMP, or SAFe certification.
* Experience in cybersecurity is a plus.
* Prefer degree in a technical area.
* Experience applying AI tools and automation platforms (e.g., Copilot, Claude, Notion AI, or similar) to enhance program management workflows such as meeting summarization, dependency tracking, and automated reporting.
* Demonstrated interest or experience in evaluating and piloting AI/ML\-driven solutions within a program or product management context to improve operational efficiency and team productivity.


**On\-Camera Policy**
 To support a fair, transparent, and engaging interview experience, candidates interviewing remotely are expected to be on camera during all video interviews. Being on camera fosters authentic connection, improves communication, and allows for full engagement from both candidates and interviewers. We understand that technical, bandwidth, or location\-related challenges may occasionally prevent video use. If this applies, candidates are required to notify us in advance so we can explore appropriate accommodations.
   

  

**About Arctic Wolf**
 At Arctic Wolf, we foster a collaborative and inclusive work environment that thrives on diversity of thought, background, and culture. This is reflected in our multiple awards, including Top Workplace USA (2021\-2025\), Best Places to Work – USA (2021\-2025\), Great Place to Work – Canada (2021\-2024\), Great Place to Work – UK (2024\-2026\), and Kununu Top Company – Germany (2024\-2026\). Our commitment to bold growth and shaping the future of security operations is matched by our dedication to customer satisfaction, with over 10,000 customers worldwide and more than 2,000 channel partners globally. As we continue to expand globally and enhance our technology, Arctic Wolf remains the most trusted name in the industry.
   

  

**Our Values**
 Arctic Wolf recognizes that success comes from delighting our customers, so we work together to ensure that happens every day. We believe in diversity and inclusion, and truly value the unique qualities and unique perspectives all employees bring to the organization. And we appreciate that—by protecting people’s and organizations’ sensitive data and seeking to end cyber risk— we get to work in an industry that is fundamental to the greater good.
   

  

 We celebrate unique perspectives by creating a platform for all voices to be heard through our Pack Unity program. We encourage all employees to join or create a new alliance. See more about our Pack Unity here.
   

  

 We also believe and practice corporate responsibility, and have recently joined the Pledge 1% Movement, ensuring that we continue to give back to our community. We know that through our mission to End Cyber Risk we will continue to engage and give back to our communities.
   

  

 All

9565ddb3.title: Program Manager/Senior Member, Program Management (GAI Tech)
9565ddb3.company: D. E. Shaw India Private Limited
9565ddb3.description:
The D. E. Shaw group is a global investment and technology development firm with more than $90 billion in investment capital as of March 1, 2026, and offices in North America, Europe, and Asia. Since our founding in 1988, our firm has earned an international reputation for successful investing based on innovation, careful risk management, and the quality and depth of our staff. We have a significant presence in the world’s capital markets, investing in a wide range of companies and financial instruments in both developed and developing economies.
   

  

 We are looking for an experienced program manager to join our GAITech team at our firm’s office in Hyderabad or Bengaluru. You will be responsible for program management across all sub\-teams within GAITech and collaborate with various HC functions to run a GAI learning plan for the entire India firm’s staff. The GAITech team is responsible for building infrastructure and applications of Generative AI (GAI) within the firm. The team's objectives consist of identifying the most productive GAI models, providing tools for sophisticated GAI\-based applications, creating initial iterations of GAI tools, and offering support for technical staff involved with GAI projects. The focus of GAITech will be on improving areas such as developer productivity, process efficiency, making DESCO data easy to use with LLMs, and promoting generative AI for BU\-specific adoption. Additionally, a significant aspect of GAITech's role focuses on user education and promoting interdepartmental collaboration. The mission of GAITech is to serve as a catalyst for the research, development, and integration of GAI technologies, emphasizing user education and support for other technical teams within the organization. The team focuses on developing and integrating AI tools to enhance productivity and development. This includes AI\-powered assistants for writing and coding, tools for AI infrastructure, and custom AI components. GAITech is also dedicated to simplifying GAI utilization across the firm through optimized developer tooling, easier programmatic ways to integrate LLMs, and fostering ready\-to\-use applications for developers. Embracing open\-ended experimentation and ongoing evaluation is another critical aspect of GAITech's objectives, supporting the team's continuous quest to advance GAI models and techniques
   

  

 WHAT YOU'LL DO DAY\-TO\-DAY:
   

  

 In this position, you will be responsible for coordinating user\-facing projects across all sub\-teams in GAITech, including project prioritization and keeping stakeholders abreast of project progress with periodic communications on timelines and progress. Another major responsibility is to work with the Talent Development team to run the GAI learning plan, with the goal of upskilling staff and creating awareness about GAI tools. Additionally, you will have product management opportunities, including gathering and prioritizing product/feature requirements and specifications, defining the product vision, and working closely with various teams.
   

  

 WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR:
   

  

 Basic qualifications:
   

  

* A master’s or bachelor’s degree in computer science or a related technical field with 3 to 8 years of technical program management experience and at least 1 year of software development experience in any language
* Exposure to GAI projects
* Exceptional stakeholder engagement skills
* Excellent communication skills


 Preferred qualifications:
   

  

* Program Management related academic qualifications (e.g. MBA, PMP)


 Interested candidates can apply through our website: https://www.deshawindia.com/recruit/jobs/Ads/Link/PrMgrSrMemGAITechApr26
   

  

 We encourage candidates with relevant experience looking to restart their careers after a break to apply for this position. Learn about Recommence, our gender\-neutral return\-to\-work initiative.
   

  

 The Firm offers excellent benefits, a casual, collegial working environment, and an attractive compensation package. For further information about our recruitment process, including how applicant data will be processed, please visit https://www.deshawindia.com/careers.
   

  

 Members of the D. E. Shaw group do not discriminate in employment matters on the basis of sex race, colour, caste, creed, religion, pregnancy, national origin, age, military service eligibility, veteran status, sexual orientation, marital status, disability, or any other protected class.

f5271ea7.title: Lead Technical Program Manager
f5271ea7.description:
**Job Description**
 Lead Technical Program Manager would be responsible for the transition, delivery governance, and execution oversight of WSP Digital Products. The role would coordinate product onboarding, roadmap execution, cross\-functional delivery planning, release readiness, operational readiness, and leadership reporting to ensure products move from MVP/transition state into stable, governed, and sustainable WSP\-owned operations.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Product Transition \& Portfolio Governance**
* Lead transition planning and execution for current and future digital products entering the portfolio
* Create and maintain product transition roadmaps, milestone plans, dependency trackers, risk registers, and readiness checklists.
* Coordinate knowledge transfer, documentation readiness, operational handover, and ownership transition from partner or vendor teams.
* Establish a repeatable product onboarding approach for upcoming products in the pipeline.


**Program Delivery \& Execution Management**
* Drive cross\-functional planning across product, architecture, development, QA, DevOps, data, release, and support teams.
* Track delivery progress, scope, milestones, dependencies, RAID items, decisions, and action owners.
* Support sprint, release, transition, and stabilization planning across multiple product workstreams.
* Ensure delivery execution is aligned to product priorities, business outcomes, technical readiness, and operational constraints.


**Stakeholder Management \& Leadership Reporting**
* Act as the primary coordination point between product owners, business stakeholders, engineering leads, architects, support teams, and leadership.
* Prepare concise leadership updates covering accomplishments, risks, blockers, decisions required, and upcoming milestones.
* Facilitate governance forums, steering reviews, transition checkpoints, and escalation discussions.
* Translate technical delivery status into clear business impact and decision\-support information.


**Operational Readiness \& Continuous Improvement**
* Ensure release readiness, support readiness, documentation readiness, monitoring readiness, and product handover closure.
* Support definition of product operating model, support model, escalation path, SLA/SLO expectations, and operational KPIs.
* Identify delivery bottlenecks, process gaps, transition risks, and improvement opportunities across product operations.
* Contribute to SOPs, governance playbooks, transition templates, and product operating standards.


**Required Technical Skills**
* Technical Program Management \| Advanced — transition planning, roadmap tracking, milestone management, RAID governance, and cross\-functional execution
* Product Delivery Governance \| Advanced — product onboarding, ownership transition, release readiness, operational readiness, and decision tracking
* Agile / Product Delivery \| Proficient — backlog awareness, sprint/release planning support, delivery tracking, and dependency management
* Stakeholder Communication \| Advanced — leadership reporting, steering reviews, escalation management, and business/technology translation
* Cloud / SaaS Awareness \| Proficient — enterprise digital products, integrations, DevOps, QA, support models, and SaaS operating considerations
* Risk \& Dependency Management \| Advanced — risk mitigation, assumption tracking, dependency resolution, and governance\-based delivery control.


**Required Experience**
* Minimum 10 years of professional experience in technical program management, delivery management, product operations, or enterprise software delivery.
* Experience leading product transition, product onboarding, vendor\-to\-internal\-team handover, or MVP\-to\-production stabilization programs.
* Proven ability to coordinate delivery across product, architecture, engineering, DevOps, QA, data, business, and support teams.
* Experience preparing senior leadership reports, steering committee updates, RAID logs, decision logs, and transition status packs.
* Strong understanding of Agile delivery, DevOps ways of working, release governance, and enterprise product operating models.


**Preferred (Not Required)**
* Experience working with enterprise SaaS, cloud\-hosted products, digital platforms, or integration\-heavy applications.
* Experience in engineering, environmental, consulting, infrastructure, or professional\-services technology domains.
* Exposure to CAB, ITIL change/release governance, service transition, SOP creation, and operational readiness processes.
* Familiarity with Azure DevOps, Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, Power BI, or similar delivery governance tools.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
* PMP, SAFe, Scrum Master, Agile, or ITIL certification is preferred but not mandatory.


 BGV
   

  

* Employment with WSP India is subject to the successful completion of a background verification ("BGV") check conducted by a third\-party agency appointed by WSP India.
* Candidates are advised to ensure that all information provided during the recruitment process — including documents uploaded — is accurate and complete, both to WSP India and its BGV partner.


**About Us**
 WSP is one of the world's leading professional services consulting firms. We are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower. We are technical experts and strategic advisors including engineers, technicians, scientists, architects, planners, surveyors and environmental specialists, as well as other design, program and construction management professionals. We design lasting solutions in the Transportation \& Infrastructure, Property \& Buildings, Earth \& Environment, Power \& Energy, Resources and Industry sectors, as well as offering strategic advisory services. Our talented people around the globe engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
   

  

 With approximately
 **4,000 talented people** 
 across 3 locations (Noida, Bengaluru \& Mumbai offices) in India and more than
 **73,000 globally** 
 , in 550
 **offices across 40 countries** 
 , we engineer projects that will help societies grow for lifetimes to come.
   

  

 At “WSP” we draw on the diverse skills and capabilities of our employees globally to compete for the most exciting and complex projects across the world and bring the same level of expertise to our local communities. We are proud to be an international collective of innovative thinkers who work on the most complex problems. Uniﬁed under one strong brand, we use our local expertise, international reach and global scale to prepare our cities and environments for the future, connect communities and help societies thrive in built and natural ecosystems. True to our guiding principles, our business is built on four cornerstones:
 **Our People, Our Clients, Our Operational Excellence and Our Expertise.**
**www.wsp.com**
**We are**
* Passionate people doing purposeful and sustainable work that helps shape our communities and the future.
* A collaborative team that thrives on challenges and unconventional thinking.
* A network of experts channeling our curiosity into creating solutions for complex issues.


***Inspired by diversity, driven by inclusion, we work with passion and purpose.***
**Working with Us**
 At WSP, you can access our global scale, contribute to landmark projects and connect with the brightest minds in your field to do the best work of your life. You can embrace your curiosity in a culture that celebrates new ideas and diverse perspectives. You can experience a world of opportunity and the chance to shape a career as unique as you.
   

  

**Our Hybrid Working Module**
 With us, you can operate in a flexible, agile, yet structured work environment and follow a Hybrid Work Model.
   

  

* Maximize collaboration.
* Maintain product quality and cultural integrity.
* Balance community, collaboration, opportunity, productivity, and efficiency.


**Health, Safety and Wellbeing**
 Our people are our greatest asset, and we prioritize a safe work environment. Health, safety, and wellbeing are integral to our culture, with each of us accountable for fostering a safe workplace through our “Making Health and Safety Personal” initiative. Our Zero Harm Vision drives us to reduce risks through innovative solutions, earning recognition for our global health and safety practices with the prestigious RoSPA Health and Safety Awards for six consecutive years.
   

  

**Inclusivity and Diversity**
 WSP India is dedicated to fostering a sustainable and inclusive work environment where our greatest strength \- Our People \-feel valued, respected, and supported. We ensure an unbiased approach in hiring, promotion, and performance evaluation, regardless of age, gender identity, race, religion, sexual orientation, marital status, physical ability, education, social status, or cultural background.
   

  

**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**
 Join our close\-knit community of over 73,300 talented global professionals dedicated to making a positive impact. Together, we can make a difference in communities both near and far.
   

  

**With us, you can.
   

  

 Apply today.**
**NOTICE TO THIRD PARTY AGENCIES:**
*WSP does not accept unsolicited resumes from recruiters, employment agencies, or other staffing services. Unsolicited resumes include any resume or hiring document sent to WSP in the absence of a signed Service Agreement where WSP has expressly requested recruitment/staffing services specific to the position at hand. Any unsolicited resumes, including those submitted to hiring managers or other business leaders, will become the property of WSP and WSP will have the right to hire that candidate without reservation – no fee or other compensation will be owed or paid to the recruiter, employment agency, or other staffing service.*

**About Teads**
 Teads is a leading omnichannel advertising platform focused on driving outcomes for brand and performance advertisers across screens. With a focus on meaningful business outcomes for branding and performance objectives, Teads drives value by leveraging predictive AI technology to connect quality media, beautiful brand creative, and context\-driven addressability and measurement. ### **Job Information**

* Job Type Full time
* Industry IT Services
* Remote Job
### **Job Description**


This is a remote position.


Job Description – SAP S/4HANA Embedded Analytics \& SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) Developer  

  

Position Summary  

  

We are seeking an experienced SAP S/4HANA Embedded Analytics and SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC) Developer to design, develop, and deliver enterprise analytics and reporting solutions. The role will focus on leveraging S/4HANA Embedded Analytics, ABAP CDS Views, Analytical Queries, and SAP Analytics Cloud to provide real\-time operational and management reporting.  

  

The ideal candidate should have strong hands\-on experience with the S/4HANA Virtual Data Model (VDM), CDS\-based analytical modeling, SAC dashboards/stories, and integration between SAP S/4HANA and SAC.  

  

Key Responsibilities  

  

SAP S/4HANA Embedded Analytics  

  

Design and develop ABAP CDS Views for operational and analytical reporting requirements.  

  

Develop CDS\-based Basic, Composite, Consumption, Cube, and Analytical Query views following SAP recommended practices.  

  

Work with the SAP S/4HANA Virtual Data Model (VDM) and maximize reuse of SAP standard CDS views before developing custom solutions.  

  

Develop and enhance S/4HANA Embedded Analytics solutions for real\-time reporting.  

  

Create CDS annotations for analytics, UI, semantics, associations, authorization, and consumption requirements.  

  

Implement CDS access controls/DCL and ensure analytical solutions comply with appropriate data authorization requirements.  

  

Develop calculated measures, restricted measures, filters, parameters, hierarchies, and other analytical query functionality.  

  

Perform CDS View and analytical query performance analysis and optimization.  

  

  

  

AP Analytics Cloud (SAC)  

  

Design and develop SAC Stories, dashboards, analytical applications, and visualizations based on business requirements.  

  

Build SAC solutions using Live Connections and Import/Acquired Data scenarios as appropriate.  

  

Integrate SAC with SAP S/4HANA Embedded Analytics/CDS Analytical Queries.  

  

Develop dimensions, measures, calculated measures, restricted measures, input controls, filters, hierarchies, and drill\-down capabilities.  

  

Optimize SAC stories and dashboards for performance and usability.  

  

Support SAC content transport and deployment across development, quality, and production environments.  

  

Technical Responsibilities  

  

Translate functional and reporting requirements into scalable analytical solutions.  

  

Work closely with S/4HANA functional teams, business stakeholders, data teams, security teams, and solution architects.  

  

Evaluate reporting requirements and recommend the appropriate solution using Embedded Analytics, SAC, or a combination of both.  

  

Perform data validation and reconciliation between S/4HANA transactional data, CDS Views, Analytical Queries, and SAC reports.  

  

Troubleshoot data, authorization, connectivity, and performance issues across the reporting landscape.  

  

Follow development standards, naming conventions, documentation standards, and SAP best practices.  

  

Prepare technical specifications, solution designs, unit\-test documentation, and deployment documentation.  

  

Participate in code reviews, testing, defect resolution, cutover, and post\-production support.  

  

Required Technical Skills  

  

Strong hands\-on experience with SAP S/4HANA Embedded Analytics.  

  

Strong experience developing ABAP CDS Views.  

  

Experience with CDS annotations, associations, parameters, calculated fields, and analytical semantics.  

  

Experience with CDS Cube Views and Analytical Queries.  

  

Good understanding of the S/4HANA Virtual Data Model (VDM).  

  

Experience with SAP standard CDS View discovery and extensibility.  

  

Strong hands\-on experience with SAP Analytics Cloud (SAC).  

  

Experience developing SAC Stories and dashboards.  

  

Experience connecting SAC to SAP S/4HANA.  

  

Good understanding of SAC Live and acquired/import data connectivity approaches.  

  

Good knowledge of S/4HANA data models and business processes.  

  

Strong SQL, data modeling, debugging, and performance\-tuning skills.  

  

Qualifications \& Experience  

  

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.  

  

Approximately 4\+ years of SAP experience, with significant hands\-on experience in S/4HANA analytics.  

  

At least 3–4 years of hands\-on experience with SAP S/4HANA Embedded Analytics and/or SAP Analytics Cloud  

  

Experience delivering end\-to\-end analytical solutions from requirements gathering through design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.

cac8b9ed.title: Senior Architect — AI Enablement
cac8b9ed.description:
**Bring more to life.**


Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?


At Cepheid, one of Danaher’s 15\+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.


You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.


At Cepheid, we are passionate about improving health care through fast, accurate, molecular diagnostic systems and tests. As a member of our team, you’ll get to make an immediate, measurable impact on a global scale, within an environment that fosters career growth and development. Our mission drives us to develop groundbreaking solutions for the world’s most complex health challenges. Together, we bring MORE change to the world.


Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.


The **Senior Architect — AI Enablement** is responsible for serving as the guiding star for AI across our software engineering organization. This is not a strategy\-only role: associate will be personally building proofs of concept, embed with scrum teams to implement AI\-driven solutions, and shape how our organization adopts AI — from developer productivity tooling to AI capabilities in our products. Associate will work across all engineering teams and their leaders, and partner with Danaher\-level AI leadership to ensure our direction stays aligned with the broader enterprise AI strategy.


.


This position reports to the VP Software, Cepheid and is part of the Software Engineering located in IDC Bangalore and will be an on\-site role.

**In this role, you will have the opportunity to:**

* Hands\-on AI implementation \- Design, build, and demonstrate AI proofs of concept (POCs) that solve real problems for our teams, and carry successful POCs through to production\-ready patterns.
* Implement solutions using modern AI tooling — LLM APIs, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG), agentic frameworks, AI coding assistants — integrated with our Java\-based technology stack.
* Establish reference architectures, reusable components, and coding standards for AI features so teams can adopt them quickly and safely.
* Drive AI adoption across teams \- Act as the organization's AI evangelist and trusted advisor: coach engineers, managers, product owners, and directors on where and how AI can improve their work.
* Set Strategy, trends, and governance for the s/w organization \- Continuously scan industry trends in AI/GenAI, evaluate emerging tools and models, and recommend enhancements to the organization's AI roadmap.

**The essential requirements of the job include**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. 16\+ years of software engineering experience, including 5\+ years in an architect or technical leadership role.


\- Strong hands\-on Java expertise (e.g., Spring Boot, microservices, REST APIs) with a track record of shipping production systems. \- Proven experience building AI/GenAI POCs and taking at least some of them into production.

* Demonstrated hands\-on experience with AI tools and technologies: LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Azure OpenAI, or similar), prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, vector databases, and AI coding assistants (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude Code).
* Excellent communication and influencing skills — able to work effectively across multiple teams, senior leaders, and enterprise stakeholders without direct authority.
* Ability to translate business problems into pragmatic, implementable AI solutions and to explain technical trade\-offs to non\-technical audiences.

**It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:**

* Experience with agentic AI frameworks, MCP, or workflow orchestration (e.g., LangChain, LlamaIndex, Spring AI).
* Familiarity with MLOps/LLMOps practices: evaluation, monitoring, cost management, and guardrails for AI systems.
* Experience driving AI adoption or developer\-productivity programs in a multi\-team engineering organization.


Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real\-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.


For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

We drive cross\-company alignment and execution, ensuring that we consistently exceed customers’ expectations in every interaction, whether in\-product, digital, or human\-centered. Join CE\&S and help us accelerate AI transformation for our customers and the world.

Leverage your architectural and engineering expertise to help customers unlock the full value of Microsoft Teams, SharePoint, and Copilot within the ABS ecosystem. Be part of a dynamic, growing team that delivers world\-class engineering and professional services.  \#\# 7\. Continuous Learning \& Thought Leadership

* Customer value realization from Copilot adoption

 We are the technology backbone of leading Life Sciences, Healthcare and Biotech organizations
   

 around the world. As the offshore technology delivery center for PTP.Cloud, we bring over two decades of expertise
   

 in designing, securing and operating complex cloud and infrastructure environments. Our teams work across
   

 Cybersecurity, Infrastructure, Networking, DevOps, FinOps, SecOps and UserOps, supporting customers where
   

 reliability, security and compliance are business critical.
   

 The work you do here goes beyond keeping systems running. From enabling scientific research to supporting drug
   

 discovery and healthcare innovation, you'll help build and operate technology that has the potential to improve and
   

 save lives. At Stratogent, you'll solve real customer challenges, work alongside highly skilled professionals and build
   

 deep technical expertise.
   

 We believe in accelerated growth through ownership, giving people meaningful responsibility and opportunities to
   

 learn from day one. Your ideas are heard, your contributions are visible, and your impact is recognized. We invest in
   

 continuous learning, collaboration and career growth while fostering a culture where you can bring your authentic
   

 self to work.
   

 Be Seen. Be Heard. Be You.
   

 Role Overview
   

 As a Service Delivery Manager (SDM), you will lead the end\-to\-end delivery of IT infrastructure and managed
   

 services, ensuring exceptional customer experience, operational excellence, and continuous service improvement.
   

 You will manage and mentor a team of IT specialists, drive SLA and KPI adherence, lead customer governance
   

 through Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs), and collaborate with cross\-functional teams to resolve complex
   

 operational challenges. This role requires a strong technical foundation, leadership capabilities, and the ability to
   

 translate technical performance into business value for global customers.
   

 Key Responsibilities
   

 Customer Engagement and QBR Ownership
   

 Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) with customers, demonstrating understanding of business
   

 impact and technical delivery.
   

 Act as the primary point of contact for escalations and strategic discussions.
   

 Service Quality andGovernance
   

 Ensure ticket quality, RCA depth, and WSR accuracy across the team.
   

 Monitor SLA/KPI adherence and drive corrective actions proactively.
   

 Team Leadership and Development
   

 Mentor and guide SDAs and L2s to improve delivery standards.
   

 Identify skill gaps and work with HR and the internal team to upskill the team.
   

 Process Improvement and Reporting
   

 Own and improve delivery processes, including incident management, change management, and problem
   

 management.
   

 Provide meaningful insights in reports that link technical performance to business outcomes.
   

 Collaboration andStakeholder Management
   

 Work closely with internal stakeholders to align delivery with customer expectations.
   

 Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to resolve systemic issues.
   

 Skills and Competencies

 Prior Experience in Windows Administration and Cloud infrastructure
   

 MSP/Managed Services/IT Services background
   

 Must have prior experience of onsite\-offshore delivery model and should have directly worked with
   

 US/European customers and colleagues.
   

 Experience in leading technical teams and driving performance
   

 Strong project management and customer\-facing experience
   

 Must have ITIL process knowledge
   

 Good to Have
   

 MSP/Managed Services/IT Services background
   

 Exposure to Hybrid Cloud Environments
   

 Experience in service transition or infrastructure migration projects
   

 Certifications: ITIL, PMP or other Project Management.

90f49fdf.title: Program Manager
90f49fdf.description:
**Program Manager \- Haryana's GenAI Ready Naari Program** 




  





**Organization:** 
 Nimaya Foundation (https://www.nimaya.in/)
 



**Location:** 
 Faridabad (mandatory)
 



**Work Mode:** 
 Hybrid (Field Visits \+ Remote Work)
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Reports To:** 
 Chief Operating Officer, Nimaya Foundation 
 



  





**About Nimaya Foundation** 




  





 Nimaya is a
 **future\-ready not\-for\-profit cofounded in 2021 by Navya Nanda and Samyak Chakrabarty, focused on preparing young women facing socio\-economic barriers for a world of work being rapidly reshaped by AI and emerging technologies.** 




  





 As GenAI transforms industries, workflows and hiring expectations,
 **Nimaya works at the intersection of employability and AI readiness to ensure our Nimaya Naaris are not replaced by AI, but instead are equipped to participate and lead in this new economy** 
 .
 



 In partnership with institutions such as the
 **Government of India's IndiaAI Mission** 
 , we have
 **enabled 10,000\+ Nimaya Naaris across 5 states** 
 to step into the new world of work with our flagship program \- the GenAI Ready Naari.
 



  





**Learn more about our mission and the impact we create!** 



* https://www.youtube.com/watch?v\=D2q\-qB\-J1Dk
* https://www.ptinews.com/story/entertainment/navya\-nanda\-and\-samyak\-chakrabarty\-s\-nimaya\-partners\-with\-govt\-s\-ai\-mission/3249973
* https://mastersunion.org/blog/how\-navya\-nanda\-and\-samyak\-chakrabarty\-are\-changing\-lives\-with\-nimaya



  





**What's exciting about this role?** 




  





*Imagine being the execution engine of a program that can change the trajectory of a young naari's future in Faridabad, someone who may never have been told that AI, technology, and ambitious careers could belong to her too.* 




  





 This is not a traditional operations role. As a Program Manager, you will own the outcomes of the Faridabad program: the learner targets, the field operations, the partner relationships, and implementing our Agentic AIs to streamline compliance \& reporting. 
 



  





**You will be the person accountable for making 700 learner journeys actually happen.** 




  





 What does that mean for you? As Program Manager, you get the chance to:
 


* **Own end\-to\-end delivery of the Faridabad program** 
 : cohort planning, enrolment pipeline, batch scheduling, and the 700\-learner target
* **Lead and manage the on\-ground field team,** 
 setting weekly priorities and reviewing delivery quality
* **Coordinate with trainers, internal team, and on\-ground stakeholders** 
 to ensure smooth delivery.
* **Own program data and reporting** 
 : operational trackers, impact dashboards and funder reports



  





**Nimaya's GenAI Ready Naari Program** 




  





 The GenAI Ready Naari Program equips young women with Generative AI skills and future\-ready workplace competencies through
 **40 hours of immersive, hands\-on learning** 
 , out of which 32 hours are offline training and 8 hours are online. In these sessions, Naaris explore:
 


* Building Chatbots \& training Agentic AIs
* AI\-powered research \& communication tactics
* Creative problem\-solving
* Presentation \& collaboration skills
* Real\-world projects \& mentorship



**The goal is not just to teach AI tools but to make learners truly future\-ready for what the modern workplace demands: the ability to confidently work with AI instead of feeling threatened by it.** 




  





**The Project you will join** 




 If selected, you will step into the role of
 **Program Manager of Nimaya's Haryana GenAI Ready Naari Program** 




 Over the next year, this project aims to:
 


* **Upskill 700 young women across Faridabad**
* Expand GenAI learning to
 **areas where access to AI exposure is still limited**
* Ensure
 **meaningful learner outcomes beyond certification**



  





**What We're Looking For** 




  





***Mindset***



* Sees CSR not as charity, but as a nation\-building investment.
* Obsessed with detail but driven by the big picture.
* **Proactive Attitude:** 
 Willingness to take initiative and demonstrate adaptability.
* **Passion for Empowerment:** 
 A strong desire to support and enable the success of young women from restrictive circumstances.



  





**Background** 



* **3\-5 years of experience** 
 in program management, partnerships, or a related strategic role (development sector experience preferred)
* Demonstrated experience
 **managing or overseeing field/ops teams** 
 , not just individual delivery
* **Excellent written and verbal communication skills** 
 ; strong stakeholder and partner management experience
* **Strong proficiency in Excel / Google Sheets** 
 and comfort working with program data to build reports and presentations
* Familiarity with compliance, documentation, and structured reporting systems
* Strong communication skills in English and Hindi
* **Comfortable with travel** 
 within Faridabad
* **Based in Faridabad (mandatory)**



  





**How to Apply** 




 If you're a self\-motivated individual eager to contribute to a meaningful cause, we encourage you to apply. Please send your CV to contact@nimaya.in. Use the subject line "Application: Program Manager, Faridabad \- \[Your Name]" so we can track your application. Women candidates are strongly encouraged to apply. 
 



  





*Join us at Nimaya and be part of a movement that's breaking barriers and building futures for young women with big dreams.*

26f901c2.description:
**Job Title:** 
 Solution Architect / Functional Architect \- Cloud
   

  

**Department** 
 : IT
   

  

**About Business line/Function:** 
 Wealth Management (WM) \- Strategy and Architecture
   

  

**Position Purpose:** 
 As a member of the IS Architecture team, you will be in charge of helping projects define their Solution Architecture while migrating the Information System of Wealth Management into BNPP group Cloud platform. You will review their proposals with Enterprise Architects as well as Engineering/Production teams and Security teams to ensure that solutions proposed are aligned and compliant with BNPP policies and BNPP Cloud offering.
   

  

 You will be assigned to a fixed set of IT Divisions/Departments (2 or 3\) for which you will manage the solutioning for Cloud migration and BAU evolutions of the applications under their management. In addition, you may be assigned to specific transversal projects for which you will do the solutioning end\-to\-end.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
 Direct Responsibilities
   

  

* Maintain the Division/Department architecture reference documentation all along the changes brought by projects:
* IT system diagrams (Division level, or per sub\-block)
* Application referential (with the help of Application Owners)
* Division level principles and related non\-conformities and remediation plans
* Obsolescence KPIs
* Lead the Cloud solution architecture on the projects they are assigned to:
* Supporting the Project Manager/Business Analysts during solution ideation, design, and implementation
* Collaborating with application teams and Business Analysts/Tech leads of impacted applications to design solutions consistent from a functional and technical point of view
* Ensuring the alignment of projects with our architecture principles and IT standards
* Ensuring the solution is optimized for running on our IBM Private Cloud
* Support project managers, Business analysts and technical leads along the architecture validation process by:
* Leading the build of a consistent architecture documentation
* Presenting their projects in architecture validation committee
* Being the reference point on a set of applications for support/evolution activities
* Supporting the architecture process till the go\-live
* Bringing Cloud and architecture awareness to application teams
* Being the reference architect on a set of applications for support/evolution activities (having low architecture impacts), before and after they are migrated into the Cloud platform.
* Collaborate with following roles:
* Project managers/Business analyst of major transversal projects they are assigned to
* Tech leads/Developers, to understand the architecture of the applications/screens and analyze potential issues
* Application owner, to update the referential information on applications
* Engineering and Production team, to check the availability/compatibility with infrastructure/Cloud services
* Enterprise Architects, to facilitate the review and validation process.
* Division heads to align domain objectives and roadmaps
* Business analysts to understand the business needs and design solution that are functionally consistent
* Ensure the reference documentation is updated all along the changes brought by projects:
* Application referential
* IT architecture diagrams and documents

About Aerchain (Why Us?)
 



  





 We’re rewriting the rules of procurement with an AI\-first platform that powers $20B\+ in enterprise spend.
 



  





 From $4M ARR today to $25M ARR and beyond, our mission is to build enterprise\-grade, AI\-first procurement software for global enterprises across manufacturing, FMCG, and services.
 



  





 Role Snapshot
 



  





 You’ll own enterprise accounts end\-to\-end — accountable for the outcomes they realise, from sales handover through go\-live, adoption, and value confirmation. You’ll be the single point of contact and the face of Aerchain for your accounts, make delivery predictable across clients and calm for leadership, validate that what was sold matches what the product can support, and orchestrate the delivery team behind the scenes so the customer experiences one seamless Aerchain delivery. You report to the Value Owner.
 



  





 What You’ll Drive
 



  





 Customer Ownership
 


* Own your accounts end\-to\-end — from understanding the customer’s problems to ensuring they realise value from the product.
* Be the single point of contact and the face of Aerchain for your accounts — through delivery, adoption, and outcome validation.
* Build trusted executive relationships; manage leadership expectations on readiness, residual risk, and trade\-offs.



  





 Delivery Leadership \& Governance
 



  




* Own project \& portfolio plan stability across your accounts; enforce governance, cadence, and metrics.
* Approve baselines, review delivery \& sprint health, and drive milestone predictability across every account.
* Enforce exception \& escalation governance with quality and timeliness — keep delivery calm and predictable for leadership.
* Orchestrate the delivery execution team and partners so the customer experiences one seamless Aerchain delivery; guide allocation, correct gaps, and keep the team unblocked.



  





 Solution Oversight \& Scope Discipline
 



  




* Review BRDs for feasibility, product alignment, and long\-term supportability.
* Validate sold solutions against product capability; enforce scope discipline post\-discovery.
* Confirm functional \& operational readiness at go\-live.



  





 Stakeholder \& Escalation Management
 



  




* Establish executive governance, escalation paths, and SteerCo cadence for your accounts.
* Own escalation resolution across client and internal stakeholders (Product, Sales, Tech, and delivery partners).
* Be the customer’s single point of escalation — all external escalation flows through you.



  





 Adoption \& Value Realisation
 



  




* Own post\-go\-live outcomes — stay in the loop until value is confirmed, not until the feature ships.
* Hold the customer\-value metrics standard across your accounts; track adoption and drive value realisation.
* Turn delivered outcomes into references and case studies; feed structured customer insight back into the product.



  





 You’ll thrive here if
 



  




* 8–12 years in Product/Solution Consulting, Engagement or Account Management, or Enterprise SaaS delivery, with clear progression to end\-to\-end account ownership.
* You own outcomes — you stay in the loop until value is confirmed.
* You make delivery predictable across clients, scalable across teams, and calm for leadership.
* You validate solutions against product capability and hold scope discipline under pressure.
* Executive\-level stakeholder management and structured, calm communication across every delivery stage.
* Pragmatic decision\-making under pressure, with a critical\-path focus.
* Strong B2B SaaS \& enterprise\-workflow understanding.
* Bonus: Procurement / supply chain / spend\-management domain exposure, experience with Indian \& US enterprise customers; MBA preferred.



  





 What’s In It For You
 



  




* End\-to\-end ownership of enterprise accounts, with real client impact and full accountability for outcomes.
* Be the face of Aerchain to your customers — with the authority to make delivery happen.
* Influence product direction through structured customer feedback.
* A direct line to delivery leadership, with no bureaucracy between your judgment and the decisions that matter.
* A high\-growth environment scaling from $4M → $25M ARR and beyond.
* A culture where problem solving, ownership, and action are rewarded — and the opposite is called out.



  





 Ready to build Aerchain’s future?
 



  





 If owning enterprise outcomes end\-to\-end and making delivery predictable at scale excites
 



 you, let’s talk. Apply now and help us build the most agile enterprise SaaS story in the world.

This convergence of talent and expertise is how we help businesses reach their own "inflection point," where chaotic data becomes a strategic asset, complexity becomes clarity, and AI becomes an engine for growth. Our ultimate vision is to be the catalyst for a future where every business operates as an intelligent enterprise, with autonomous systems unlocking human potential.
   

  

 At 66degrees, we believe in thriving through challenges and winning together. These values not only guide us in achieving our goals as a company but also for our people. We are dedicated to creating a significant impact for our employees by fostering a culture that sparks innovation and supports professional and personal growth along the way.

 As a Solution Consultant, you act as a trusted advisor bridging pre\-sales architectural design with long\-term operational success. You will collaborate with Sales, Engineering, and Service Delivery teams to craft robust proposals and Statements of Work (SOWs) that ensure both successful implementations and ongoing stability for Managed Services clients.
   

  

 In partnership with the sales team, you will formulate and execute a technical sales strategy to exceed revenue objectives through the adoption of the Google Cloud Platform. As a trusted customer advocate, you will help customers understand best practices around advanced cloud\-based solutions, and how to migrate existing workloads to these solutions. Additionally you will educate customers of all sizes on the value proposition of Cloud and participate in deep architectural discussions to ensure solutions are designed for successful deployment in the cloud or on\-premise as needed.

* SLA Management: Ensuring deliverables and services meet defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Incident Management \& RCA: Participating in or leading Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for critical production issues to ensure ongoing system reliability.

**Responsibilities**

* Build strong relationships with key stakeholders and decision\-makers to drive customer success and satisfaction.
* Specify the deliverables of services projects by developing detailed project Statement of work (SOWs).
* Put on consulting hat during stakeholder engagements and drive full stack thinking around both business and technology levers
* Assist the sales team with the preparedness and delivery of technical presentations, estimations, and Statements of Work.

* Differentiate 66degrees products and services from our competitors by understanding the market and industry intimately.
* Design and propose custom cloud based solutions for clients based on your research and their needs.
* Prepare demonstrations and proof of concept environments based on client requirements.
* Act as a technical resource for our team by continually bringing value and an innovative mindset to our projects.
* Assist with and perform deliverable work for clients to gain first\-hand experience with solutions.
* Embrace 66degrees team mentality by providing our team general support on new products and technology in the market.


**Qualifications**
* 8\+ years of experience working within Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or Azure/AWS; GCP Preferred.
* Professional level certification in GCP is required within first 90 days of employment.
* Experience strategizing, designing, architecting, and leading the deployment of scalable solutions on GCP, strongly preferred.
* Experience with traditional and cloud infrastructure as well as cloud migrations.
* Experience with the primary managed data services within GCP, including Cloud Bigtable, Cloud Spanner, Cloud SQL, or BigQuery.
* Experience with using AI Platform, GE Agent Platform, Agent Studio, or BigQuery ML to manage and deploy machine learning models.
* Specify the deliverables of services projects by developing detailed project scopes of work (SOWs); Assist sales team with preparedness and delivery of technical presentations, estimations, and Statements of Work.
* Experience with container engines: Kubernetes, Docker, AWS Elastic Container Service.
* Experience with automation technologies including Terraform, Google Cloud Deployment Manager, AWS Cloud Formation or Microsoft Azure Automation
* Experience working with engineering and sales teams to elicit customer requirements.
* Ability to communicate across business units and the ability to interface with and communicate complex technical concepts to a broad range of internal and external stakeholders
* Advocate and demonstrate the value of the Google Cloud and service offerings to prospects.
* India: Willingness to work 12\.30pm to 9\.30pm IST shift for overlap with global team.
* Experience within a Managed Services Provider (MSP) or large\-scale enterprise environment.
* Demonstrated understanding of SLA\-driven service delivery and operational best practices.


***Please note, we cannot sponsor or transfer any visas, of any kind, at this time.***
*66degrees is an Equal Opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to actual or perceived race, color, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, national origin, age, weight, height, marital status, sexual orientation, veteran status, disability status or other legally protected class.*

fed71e8f.title: Lead Principal Site Reliability Engineer(Python, Kubernetes & Cloud Infra)
fed71e8f.description:
**Career Level – IC5**

We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced **Site Reliability Developer** to join the Engineering team within the SaaS Apps and Delivery organization. This IC5 role will provide technical leadership in designing, developing, operating, and continuously improving reliable, scalable, and secure cloud\-native services running on Kubernetes in Oracle Cloud Infrastructure.


The successful candidate will own complex reliability and automation initiatives, influence technical direction across teams, and help establish engineering standards for deployment, observability, resilience, and operational excellence.


**Qualifications**

* MCA, BE, MS in Computer Science, or equivalent practical experience.
* 10\+ years of experience designing, developing, and operating large\-scale, customer\-facing web services or cloud platforms.
* Demonstrated experience leading complex technical initiatives and influencing architecture or engineering practices across teams.
* Strong expertise in Kubernetes, container technologies, and managing production applications in Kubernetes environments.
* Strong understanding of Cloud PaaS, SaaS, and IaaS environments; Linux, Windows, or Solaris administration; infrastructure security; compliance; monitoring; and instrumentation.
* Proven experience with multi\-region architectures, high availability, disaster recovery, and capacity or performance engineering.
* Strong hands\-on experience automating infrastructure and deployments using Terraform.
* Extensive experience designing and optimizing CI/CD pipelines, with GitLab, Git, Jenkins, and modern branching strategies.
* Proficiency in Python preferred, with experience in one or more of Bash, Golang, PowerShell, JavaScript, or Java.
* Strong understanding of automation, orchestration, Agile development, DevOps, and SRE practices.
* Ability to create and review technical architecture documentation and operational runbooks.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, written, and verbal communication skills.
* A collaborative mindset, with the ability to mentor others and drive adoption of new cloud technologies and engineering practices.

  
**Key Responsibilities**  

**Application Software Development:**

* Architects and delivers multi\-team features and modernization initiatives with clear, organization\-level KPIs.
* Establishes global production\-readiness standards (SLOs, error budgets, incident tooling) and drives adoption.
* Diagnoses and resolves high\-severity, multi\-system failures; creates systemic reliability improvements across apps/OCI.
* Harmonizes QA strategy across teams (test pyramids, non\-functional testing) to ensure consistent app quality.
* Makes significant architectural decisions; leads migrations and pattern adoptions with deprecation plans.
* Creates scalable blueprints and reference implementations adopted by multiple teams.
* Defines cross\-team API governance and dependency management frameworks.
* Shapes prioritization across multiple teams using data from field/customer, telemetry, and live\-site signals.
* Institutionalizes feedback loops into planning cadences; measures impact.
* Mentors Staff engineers; partners with Product and Design to balance customer value and technical strategy.

**Software Development and Coding \- Design, Testing, and Optimization:**

* Leads project initiatives to design software solutions and identify and analyze requirements. Writes and defines foundational code for new projects or prototypes.
* Adheres to and improves execution of all phases of the software development lifecycle; coaches engineers across teams or units to drive improvements.
* Acts as a subject matter expert within the organization to develop and guide new software features and enhancements following design specifications, ensuring accessibility, and develops documents to clarify software design and code.
* Leads process, architecture, and code reviews across projects and/or products/services to drive improvements.
* Utilizes modern/emerging technologies to conduct debugging and troubleshooting to identify and fix highly complex software issues.
* Leads strategic initiatives to optimize software testing (e.g., functional and non\-functional), quality assurance processes, software error logging, monitoring, and observability for effective debugging.
* Encourages innovation, research, and relevant industry practices to optimize performance across products and domains.
* Resolves and may troubleshoot highly complex and systematic issues requiring innovation related to application programming interface (API) functionality and integration.
* Implements innovative API versioning, lifecycle, and interoperability strategies.

**Software Architecture \- Software System Structural Design:**

* Leads task and project initiatives for the design and development of software, systems, and services. Defines project or design scope; reviews, influences, and approves scope and design recommendations.
* Provides technical guidance, domain expertise, and coaching in software architecture decisions and best practices that drive key organizational decisions, including industry standards and competitive considerations, providing mentorship and coaching for small teams and peers and contributing to both individual and team development across line of business/function.
* Utilizes innovative methods to conduct highly complex periodic reviews and ensures adherence to architectural standards.
* Collaborates with stakeholders across lines of business and externally, to align and build software architecture with business and/or customer goals and priorities.
* Implements innovative performance optimization and scalability strategies in software design.
* Conducts regular technology research and evaluation for architectural enhancements and translates into decisions and plans that can have a major impact on the organization.

**Issue/Defect Collaboration \- Software Products Support:**

* Collaborates with stakeholders internally and externally to lead efforts to understand customer issues, root causes, and mitigation to align and explain rationale behind solutions.
* Must provide expert technical guidance and support to customers regarding customer\-reported issues to mitigate recurrence.
* Acts as an advisor to advocate for customers' interests and suggests product enhancements and solutions based on feedback.
* Networks across lines of business to ensure customer satisfaction through timely resolution of issues and effective communication.
* Guides implementation of strategic solutions for customer issue and/or defect handling and training processes.
* Investigates and troubleshoots the most complex and broadly reaching product maintenance issues to ensure customer agreement on short\- and long\-term solutions (e.g., future enhancements).

**Practices and Standards Compliance \- Security and Compliance:**

* Collaborates with the security team and leadership teams to establish, follow, and improve upon development practices and coding standards, providing coaching to less experienced team members.
* Participates in peer review processes and provides technical leadership with initiatives to ensure quality and adherence to broad acceptance criteria during development.
* Demonstrates, contributes to, and shares deep expertise of industry best practices and their application to software development processes.
* Implements highly complex secure software development practices/solutions requiring modern/emerging innovation to prevent security vulnerabilities, leveraging automated solutions to augment the manual review process.

**Development Operations \- System Maintenance:**

* Leads project initiatives for periodic maintenance and testing operations for systems that require upgrading or patching (e.g., for critical vulnerabilities).
* Acts as subject matter expert to drive improvements, ensures automation, testing, and debugging of systems to ensure service/product availability, health, support, and reliability.

**Core Responsibilities**  

**Planning \& Execution:**

* Manages and provides direction on timelines, deliverables, and budgets when applicable for critical high\-impact projects or initiatives that impact the line of business, ensuring timely completion and adherence to requirements.
* Anticipates and plans for shifts in resources or timelines based on changing business priorities, ensuring optimal outcomes.

**Collaboration \& Partnership:**

* Influences cross\-functional leaders and external stakeholders to gain alignment on strategic objectives.
* Fosters partnerships with key business leaders, stakeholders, and/or customers, identifying opportunities for expanding partnerships and promoting long\-term organizational success.
* Champions transparency and inclusivity by actively seeking, listening to, and incorporating diverse perspectives.

**Problem Solving:**

* Leads specialized, advanced problem\-solving efforts, serving as an escalation point for complex issues.
* Guides others to leverage innovative data\-driven techniques to address ambiguous or novel issues, identify root causes, and drives the implementation of solutions that prevent future issues.

**Continuous Learning:**

* Leverages deep industry knowledge and expertise to serve as a thought leader within the organization.
* Contributes to the advancement of the field or industry through thought leadership (e.g., conference presentations, white papers, research contributions).
* Maintains and evolves expertise in relevant areas by proactively monitoring emerging trends, technologies, and industry standards, ensuring the organization remains current with best practices.
* Champions continuous learning and knowledge sharing, promoting professional development across teams. Applies new knowledge to drive advancement and mentors others to do the same.

**Continuous Improvement:**

* Develops innovative solutions and drives the implementation of ideas that increase the efficiency and effectiveness of processes, protocols, and workflows across the organization.
* Evaluates effectiveness of updated approaches and methods for continued improvement to enhance efficiencies and ensure changes align with organizational goals.
* Designs and develops metrics to measure success of improvement initiatives.

**Performance and Development:**

* Serves as a subject matter expert regarding talent needs and organizational talent strategy.
* Imparts leadership and expert knowledge throughout the talent development pipeline including candidate interviews, candidate assessment, and hiring decisions, ensuring alignment with organizational talent strategy.

 Solution Architect

 Translate client requirements into differentiated, deliverable solutions using in\-depth knowledge of a technology, function, or platform.  AWS Architecture
